title: Agency Lending - Collateral & Settlements - Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
 An experienced operation manager for the SSGM India COO organization with a proven record of managing processes and large teams in the area of securities lending, mark to market, SBL, Corporate actions, Settlements of FI or Equity and Collateral management.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSGM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For****
 As Agency Lending \- Collateral \& Settlements \-Manager, you will
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Processes high volume of international loans, Recall returns, Equilend \& Non\-Equilend Broker Returns daily adhering to established procedures and controls; monitors and resolves pending and failing aged Returns. Contract Compare, Billing, etc
* Interacts with traders, client management, fund group(s) and counterparts regarding discrepancies if any
* Executes instructions to receive or deliver securities from counterparties.
* Ensure that your team meets the agreed SLA, KPI and KRI and evidence of the same documented every day.
* Reviews contract compare records, DDA’s to validate positions with each counterparty.
* Assists business area with inquiries pertaining to transactional activity; coordinates response with traders, corporate actions staff and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely resolution of counterparty issues including pricing problems, quantities of loans and borrows, etc. while keeping management informed of any potential issues.
* Identifies and analyzes operations risks related to current and potential business and recommends procedural changes/improvements as needed
* Understand end to end of the process (including new ones) and contributes to process improvement ideas highlighting any potential process risk to the managers
* Demonstrates effective risk management skills – capture and communicate probability and impact to key stakeholders, ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are agreed.


**The Manager is expected to display the following Managerial qualities:**
* Demonstrate ‘Risk Excellence’ culture in your behaviour and nurture the same ethos within the team, encouraging an environment of openness and transparency that fuels effective challenge, debate and open discussion.
* Establish and nurture a culture of individual and collective ownership at the ‘captive’ giving all staff a clear sense of both responsibility and accountability. Develop effective working relationships with all SSGM staff at all levels across all locations
* Ensure that all staff adheres to the expected SSGM Code of Conduct.
* In depth knowledge of domains like\- securities lending, mark to market, SBL, Corporate actions, Settlements of FI or Equity and Collateral management.
* Should have 8 to 10 years of experience in knowledge services environment serving Capital Market in Stock lending domain, handling a team of over 5 to 10 people at a minimum.
* Communicates with other team members from diverse background in an effective manner. Influences and motivates the team. Creates an empowering climate. Projects an inspiring presence and collaborates by fostering a network of communication
* Demonstrates flexibility and effectiveness with changing environments, tasks, responsibilities \& people. Is open to change and new ideas while maintaining core goals and values. Adapts behavior and work methods in response to new information, changes or organization demands
* Ability of an individual to facilitate the continuous development of individual \& organizational competencies, developing other’s potential through the sharing of expertise and providing timely feedback. Continue to coach and mentor staff.
* Track and monitor the workflow queues/day to day workload/pending requests/mailbox to avoid any potential issues and delays and ensure 100% SLA and accuracy and timelines for BAU deliverables.
* Drive opportunities to work across groups in support of client needs, contribute in enhancing operating model and key Business Unit and Transformation initiatives, deliver on business and regulatory initiatives as per set timelines, achieve our financial commitments by providing better client service.
* Always finding better ways to improve the process\-you are responsible to drive and provide process improvement ideas to make the process and operating model better and efficient. Encourage staff to think differently. Look to provide time saves and risk reduction
* SSGM COO transformation \- understand and assess internal control environment to drive year\-over\-year improvement and enhancement of internal controls – promote self identification working in partnership with the global SSGM Business Controls teams


**Shift Time**
* Should be flexible to work in NA shift (5:00Pm to 2:00Am IST) Shift


****Subject Matter Expert In :****
* Global Markets
* Securities Finance
* Settlements and Collateral
* Securities Lending
* Mark to Market
* Depo and inventory management
* Financial Accounting
* Enhanced Custody
* Corporate Action


****Required Competencies****
* Work as a team player in a global team environment
* Ability to work and communicate with people across organizational units
* Demonstrate a high standard for customer service and proactively managing work queues
* Handling and monitoring issue and query mails and escalating issues promptly as required to Senior Management
* Strong risk mitigation, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Effective in process improvement and expense reduction
* Ability to think critically and resolve complex problems
* Strategic mindset – looking at bigger picture for the future of the organization
* Change agent with abilities to navigate challenges effectively


****Education / Experience****
* MBA/BS/BA or equivalent
* 8\+ years experience in management of multi location
* Strong management and employee relations skills


****Technical Skills – IT And Systems****
* Intermediate, demonstrable knowledge of Microsoft Office suit
* MCH
* Euroclear/CREST
* Qlikview
* DTCC
* IHS MARKIT
* PIRUM
* EQUILEND


****About State Street****
**What we do** 
 . State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

title: Area Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 Basil is a fast\-growing food brand built on transparency, real ingredients, and fresh food made to order. Instead of labeling food as “good” or “bad,” Basil focuses on serving honest meals that let guests clearly understand what they are eating. The brand currently operates over 60 outlets across Bangalore, Chandigarh, and Delhi and is rapidly expanding toward 1,000 touchpoints in the next three years. With a commitment to fast, fresh, and transparent dining, Basil is rethinking how India eats and offering growth opportunities for people who care about quality and customer experience.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Area Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for overseeing multiple Basil outlets within a defined territory. This role includes managing daily operations, ensuring adherence to brand standards, and monitoring key performance metrics such as sales, customer satisfaction, and quality. The Area Manager will coach and support outlet managers, plan staffing, oversee training, and ensure compliance with health, safety, and food hygiene requirements. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include conducting regular store visits, resolving operational issues, coordinating with central teams on marketing and supply chain, and driving local initiatives to improve efficiency and profitability.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Operational management skills, including multi\-outlet supervision, performance monitoring, and process improvement.
* Team leadership and people management skills, with experience in coaching, motivating, and developing frontline and managerial staff.
* Customer service and relationship management skills, with a focus on guest experience, feedback handling, and issue resolution.
* Analytical and planning skills, including data\-driven decision\-making, budgeting, and resource allocation.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Previous experience in food service, QSR or retail as an Area Manager is highly beneficial.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to lead service operations, manage customer relationships, ensure SLA compliance, and drive continuous service improvement. The candidate will act as the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate with technical teams, onsite engineers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure reliable and high\-quality service delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of managed IT, infrastructure, network, security, AV, and end\-user support services.
* Act as the primary service contact for assigned customers and maintain strong stakeholder relationships.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, problems, and changes are handled within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor service performance, ticket queues, response times, resolution times, escalations, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead daily, weekly, and monthly service reviews with customers and internal teams.
* Prepare and present SLA reports, service dashboards, incident summaries, availability reports, and improvement plans.
* Manage critical incidents and coordinate technical teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders until service restoration.
* Ensure Root Cause Analysis reports and corrective action plans are completed for major incidents.
* Identify recurring issues, service gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.
* Manage onsite and remote support teams, including shift planning, resource allocation, attendance, leave, and backup coverage.
* Set team objectives, review engineer performance, provide feedback, and support training and development.
* Ensure proper ticket documentation, customer communication, escalation quality, and timely closure.
* Coordinate onboarding, transition, and stabilisation of new managed\-service customers.
* Maintain service\-management documentation, escalation matrices, SOPs, runbooks, asset records, and customer\-specific procedures.
* Ensure compliance with change management, information security, access control, backup, and customer governance requirements.
* Coordinate with OEMs, third\-party vendors, and support partners for technical escalations and service restoration.
* Track contract scope, resource utilisation, service credits, penalties, renewals, and commercial risks.
* Support pre\-sales teams with effort estimation, resource planning, service scope, transition plans, and solution presentations.
* Conduct regular customer satisfaction reviews and implement agreed service\-improvement actions.
* Provide management with regular updates on service performance, customer concerns, risks, and account health.



  





**Technical and Functional Skills** 



* Strong understanding of IT managed services and service\-delivery operations.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices covering incident, problem, change, request, service\-level, and configuration management.
* Experience managing service desks, onsite support, infrastructure, network, security, cloud, AV, or end\-user support teams.
* Strong knowledge of SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, escalation management, and service\-reporting frameworks.
* Experience using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Zoho Desk, ManageEngine, Jira Service Management, or equivalent.
* Ability to prepare dashboards, service reports, RCA documents, capacity reports, and improvement plans.
* Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, backup, and business continuity.
* Experience in customer onboarding, service transition, resource planning, and operational governance.
* Working knowledge of contracts, scope management, effort estimation, and service commercials.
* Good command of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.



  





**Qualification and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 year s of experience in IT services, including at least 3–5 years in service delivery or managed\-service leadership.
* Proven experience managing enterprise customers, technical teams, SLAs, escalations, and service reviews.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification is preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, ISO 20000, or relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.



  





**Benefits** 




 • Health insurance coverage for employees and their families.
 



 • Long\-term benefit savings plan with employer matching contributions.
 



 • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization.

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

 Hub Operations Management

 Mid Mile Network Operations
   

  

  

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


 Network Coordination \& Exception Management
   

  

  

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**

* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.


 Safety, Security \& Compliance

* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.


 Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication
   

  

  

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.


 People Leadership \& Capability Development
   

  

  

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.

* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.

title: Associate Merchandise Optimization Manager [T500-29686]
description:
**About Officeworks:** 




 Officeworks’ purpose is “we bring big ideas to life at low prices”. It’s how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.
 



 We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print \& Create, and Geeks2U.
 



  





 Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools.
 



 Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to “wear the blues” and deliver for our customers.
 



  





 We are an inclusive, forward\-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect.
 



  





**About the Commercial Function:** 



* The Commercial team within the Global Capability Centre (GCC) sits at the heart of Officeworks’ growth agenda. This function brings together customer needs, product innovation, services, supplier partnerships, merchandise planning, and channel growth to shape what Officeworks sells, how it competes, and the value it delivers across Retail, B2B, Government, and Education.
* This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the business’s most commercially impactful areas. The team plays a key role in evolving Officeworks’ product and service offering, accelerating growth in high\-potential channels (such as B2B and Education), expanding private label and exclusive ranges, strengthening supplier partnerships, and unlocking emerging category opportunities across areas like technology, gaming, mobility, VR, print, installation, telco, and managed services.
* As part of the newly established GCC, you will help build commercial capability from the ground up, shaping scalable ways of working, strengthening planning and decision\-making, and driving outcomes that impact sales, margin, customer experience, inventory performance, and long\-term growth.



  





**These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:** 



* Thriving in a growth\-focused retail environment where commercial decisions directly influence customers, sales, margin, and competitiveness
* Contributing to key growth areas, including B2B, Education, Government, private label, exclusive products, and emerging categories
* Using insights (customer, competitor, category, supplier, financial, inventory) to identify opportunities and inform decisions
* Collaborating cross\-functionally to turn commercial strategy into practical outcomes



  





**Who you will be working with:** 



* Head of Merchandise Planning, Forecasting and Supply: Align the Hub’s priorities with Officeworks’ inventory strategy and escalate material decisions, risks and trade\-offs.
* Inventory Optimization Analysts: Lead performance, capability, work allocation and delivery across the Bengaluru team.
* Merchandise Planning, Replenishment and Inventory Teams: Define business problems, provide operational expertise and embed approved improvements.
* Category Management, Supply Chain and Finance: Address cross\-functional drivers of availability, inventory investment, supplier performance and stock flow.
* Technology and Data: Coordinate data access, system design, technical delivery, testing and issue resolution.
* Planning System Vendors and Delivery Partners: Support solution design, system optimization and implementation where required.



  





**What success looks like:** 



* Inventory outcomes: Approved initiatives contribute to improved availability, inventory productivity, stock flow and management of excess inventory.
* Portfolio value: Improvement work is prioritized against clear business needs and delivers measurable benefits.
* Analytical quality: Insights and recommendations are accurate, clearly explained and trusted by business stakeholders.
* Process and system improvement: Planning processes are simpler, better controlled and supported by effective system logic and automation.
* Implementation and adoption: Approved changes are tested, documented and embedded into business operations.
* Stakeholder confidence: Australian business owners have clear visibility of priorities, progress, risks and expected outcomes.
* Team capability: Inventory Optimization Analysts demonstrate strong inventory, analytical, process and system capability and deliver consistently high\-quality work.
* Cross\-location effectiveness: Bengaluru and Australian teams work through clear accountabilities, decision rights and delivery rhythms.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high\-performing culture.



  





**Our Values:** 




**Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.** 




**We begin with customer:** 



* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.



  





**We do the right thing:** 



* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks\-wide.



  





**We execute with accountability:** 



* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.



  





**We lead with ambition:** 



* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 The Associate Inventory Optimization Manager leads the Inventory Optimization team and its portfolio of analytics, process and planning system improvements. The role translates Officeworks’ inventory priorities into a structured pipeline of work and ensures analysis results in practical, measurable improvements to availability, inventory productivity and planning effectiveness.
 



 The role is accountable for the performance and capability of the Inventory Optimization Analysts and for the quality, prioritization and delivery of the team’s work. It remains close to complex analysis and solution design, providing direction, challenge and quality assurance where required.
 



 Working with merchandise planning, replenishment, supply chain, Technology and Data teams, the role identifies root causes, shapes recommendations and supports implementation. Functional business owners retain accountability for operational planning decisions, policies and performance outcomes.
 



  





**Where you will make a difference:** 




**In this role you will:** 




**Inventory Optimization and Portfolio Leadership:** 



* Translate business priorities into a clear portfolio of inventory optimization, analytics, process and system initiatives.
* Prioritize opportunities based on customer and commercial impact, inventory benefit, risk, effort and delivery capacity.
* Define and govern inventory policies, service\-level strategies and optimization parameters that balance availability, inventory investment, cost and operational constraints.
* Set clear outcomes, scope and accountabilities for initiatives and maintain visibility of progress, dependencies, risks and decisions.
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations to improve availability, inventory productivity, replenishment performance and stock flow.
* Escalate material inventory\-policy decisions, investment requirements and priority trade\-offs to the appropriate business owners and governance forums.



  





**Analytics, Process and System Optimization:** 



* Lead diagnostic analysis to identify the root causes of inventory and availability outcomes, including issues arising from forecasts, parameters, master data, constraints or system configuration.
* Oversee the development of dashboards and analysis covering measures such as availability, forecast bias, safety stock, service levels, replenishment efficiency, excess inventory and promotional performance.
* Evaluate system\-generated recommendations and ensure optimization outcomes are understood, challenged and improved where required.
* Lead the functional design, testing and optimization of inventory policies, planning logic, workflows, parameters and automation within RELEX and related systems.
* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, clearly interpreted and translated into practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
* Establish clear process documentation, controls, parameter\-governance routines and standard operating procedures for approved ways of working.
* Contribute directly to complex analysis, problem\-solving and quality assurance where additional judgement or experience is required.



  





**Transformation Delivery and Adoption:** 



* Convert approved opportunities into practical delivery plans covering requirements, functional design, testing, implementation and adoption.
* Coordinate Inventory Optimization Analysts and business subject\-matter experts through analysis, process mapping, requirements definition, scenario validation and user acceptance testing.
* Partner with functional owners to ensure solutions reflect operational requirements and can be embedded into day\-to\-day planning.
* Monitor implementation risks, dependencies and readiness, and intervene where delivery, solution quality or adoption is at risk.
* Establish benefit measures and assess whether implemented changes deliver the intended availability, inventory, efficiency and control outcomes.
* Capture lessons and apply them to future initiatives, analytical methods and implementation approaches.



  





**Stakeholder Partnership and Governance:** 



* Act as the primary interface between the Inventory Optimization and Australian inventory, replenishment and merchandise planning leaders.
* Build shared understanding of business problems, priorities, decision rights and expected outcomes before work commences.
* Work with Supply Chain, Finance, Category Management, Technology and Data teams to address cross\-functional issues affecting inventory performance.
* Provide concise reporting, insights and recommendations to support portfolio governance and inventory decision\-making.
* Manage relationships with RELEX and other planning\-system vendors or delivery partners where required.



  





**How you will lead:** 




**Line Manager:** 



* Leads a culture based on our Officeworks values and behaviours.
* Provides functional leadership across inventory optimization, setting clear standards and accountability for inventory policies, parameter governance and system\-driven outcomes.
* Builds team capability through coaching, constructive challenge and active involvement in complex inventory optimization and planning\-system decisions.
* Demonstrates resilience, has determination and drive to persist through challenge
* Is self\-aware; has humility and is self\-reflective; understands how to bring out the best in self and others
* Strong sense of personal and team accountability, drives a genuine commitment to their teams’ and individual development
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Builds inclusive teams and creates an environment where diverse perspectives, equitable opportunities and respectful behaviours enable team and business performance



  





**Qualifications and work experience:** 




**Essential:** 



* 8\+ years’ experience across inventory optimization, replenishment, supply planning, demand planning or inventory management in a complex, high\-SKU environment.
* A tertiary qualification in engineering, supply chain, operations, mathematics, statistics, data analytics or a related discipline.
* Deep expertise in inventory optimization, including service\-level strategies, safety\-stock calculations, demand and lead\-time variability, inventory segmentation, replenishment parameters, excess inventory and working capital.
* Strong understanding of how advanced planning systems translate demand, supply, inventory policies and operational constraints into inventory and replenishment recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to configure, tune and govern inventory optimization parameters, analyze system\-generated recommendations and diagnose issues arising from parameters, master data, forecasts, constraints or system configuration.
* Experience leading highly analytical and technically capable inventory optimization professionals by setting standards, reviewing analysis, challenging assumptions, developing team capability and resolving complex problems.
* Strong scenario\-modelling capability, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs between product availability, service levels, inventory investment, cost, risk and operational capacity.
* Experience improving inventory policies, optimization processes, parameter\-governance routines, system usage and data quality.
* Strong analytical capability using advanced planning systems, business intelligence tools and large, complex datasets to identify root causes and improve inventory outcomes.
* Ability to translate complex analysis and system behaviour into clear risks, options and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional influencing skills and experience working across planning, commercial, technology, data and operations teams.



  





**Preferred:** 



* Experience in omnichannel retail, particularly fast\-moving technology products.
* Experience with RELEX or a comparable planning and inventory optimization platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Power BI, Tableau or comparable analytical tools; exposure to Python would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting planning\-system implementations, inventory optimization transformations or major parameter redesigns.

 DesirableExperience deploying the same solution across multiple sites and managing the operational challenges of replication.Exposure to product\-management practices including backlogs, releases, configuration and customisation decisions.Experience in a matrix or hub\-and\-spoke organization with strong local autonomy.Multi\-region experience and comfort working across cultures and time zones.

* skills development.



  





 Incident detection and response

* containment and closure.

* response specialists where needed.

* improvements.



  





 Microsoft Sentinel platform ownership

* Develop and review KQL queries, hunting queries, workbooks and watchlists.
* Guide automation using playbooks (Logic Apps) and automation rules to reduce manual triage
* effort.

* cost optimization.



  





 Wazuh operations (where deployed)

 Customer engagement and reporting

* reviews.

* and recommendations.

* Good knowledge of networking, Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience working to customer SLAs in a multi\-tenant or managed services environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting to technical and executive audiences.

* Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CySA\+, BTL1/BTL2, or equivalent incident response credentials.

* Scripting skills in PowerShell or Python for automation and enrichment.
* Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, threat hunting programs and detection\-as\-code practices.

title: Pricing and Supplier Performance Manager [T500-29666]
description:
**About Officeworks** 




 Officeworks’ purpose is “
 **we bring** 
**big ideas to life at low prices”.** 
 It’s how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.
 



 We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print \& Create, and Geeks2U.
 



  





 Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools.
 



 Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are
 **one team who are proud to “wear the blues”** 
 and
 **deliver for our customers.** 




  





 We are an inclusive, forward\-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect.
 



  





**Our Values:** 




 Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.
 



  





**We begin with customer:** 



* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.



  





**We do the right thing:** 



* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks\-wide.



  





**We execute with accountability:** 



* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.



  





**We lead with ambition:** 



* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.



  





 The Commercial team sits at the heart of Officeworks’ growth agenda. This function brings together customer needs, product innovation, services, supplier partnerships, merchandise planning, and channel growth to shape what Officeworks sells, how it competes, and the value it delivers across Retail, B2B, Government, and Education. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the business’s most commercially impactful areas.
 



 The team plays a key role in evolving Officeworks’ product and service offering, accelerating growth in high\-potential channels (such as B2B and Education), expanding private label and exclusive ranges, strengthening supplier partnerships, and unlocking emerging category opportunities across areas like technology, gaming, mobility, VR, print, installation, telco, and managed services.
 



 You will help build commercial capability from the ground up, shaping scalable ways of working, strengthening planning and decision\-making, and driving outcomes that impact sales, margin, customer experience, inventory performance, and long\-term growth.
 



  





**These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:** 



* thriving in a growth\-focused retail environment where commercial decisions directly influence customers, sales, margin, and competitiveness
* contributing to key growth areas, including B2B, Education, Government, private label, exclusive products, and emerging categories
* using insights (customer, competitor, category, supplier, financial, inventory) to identify opportunities and inform decisions
* collaborating cross\-functionally to turn commercial strategy into practical outcomes



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 The Pricing and Supplier Performance Manager exists to improve customer value perception and profitability by leading integrated retail and B2B pricing and strengthening supplier cost and trading\-term outcomes. The role establishes the strategies, guardrails and decision frameworks that balance customer value, competitive positioning, sales growth, gross margin and compliance across consumer and business channels.
 



 The role leads the people, platforms and analytical capability required to translate pricing and Better Buying (supplier performance) strategies into controlled execution. It equips commercial and B2B teams with the insights, tools and challenge needed to make sound decisions, while improving automation, pricing accuracy and service delivery.
 



  





**Where you will make a difference:** 




 Pricing Strategy and Governance
 


* Lead the development and execution of retail and B2B pricing strategies that support customer price perception, sales, gross margin and profitability targets.
* Establish pricing principles, decision rights and margin guardrails across everyday, promotional, markdown and B2B contract pricing.
* Govern the use of customer, competitor and market insights to inform pricing decisions across merchandise categories and customer segments.
* Oversee competitive price positioning, including exposure under the Price Beat Guarantee.
* Set priorities and controls for price changes across stores, digital channels and B2B systems, ensuring accurate and timely execution.
* Maintain pricing governance and controls that support compliance with Trade Practices laws and regulations.



  





**B2B Pricing and Service Delivery:** 



* Lead the B2B pricing function through the Business Pricing Lead, overseeing contract pricing, tender support, customized quotations and customer price maintenance.
* Establish B2B pricing rules, margin floors, approval delegations and exception pathways across corporate, education and government customers.
* Partner with B2B Sales, Category Management and Finance on tenders, contract renewals and material pricing exceptions.
* Govern the performance of the Business Pricing team, including service levels, output quality, pricing accuracy and issue resolution.
* Analyze customer and contract profitability to identify margin leakage, cost recovery requirements and pricing improvement opportunities.
* Support product substitution and alternative offer strategies that protect customer value while improving contract margin.



  





**Better Buying Capability and Supplier Terms:** 



* Develop the frameworks, tools and insights that enable Category teams to improve supplier negotiations, trading terms and cost\-price outcomes.
* Establish consistent approaches for evaluating cost\-price increase requests, supplier should\-cost analysis, rebates and trading\-term opportunities.
* Build negotiation playbooks, scenario models and decision\-support tools for use during supplier reviews.
* Implement exception reporting and variance thresholds that identify cost recovery, rebate and margin improvement opportunities.
* Coach and challenge Category teams during material supplier negotiations and cost\-price increase reviews.
* Measure and report the financial value delivered through cost mitigation, trading\-term improvement and better buying initiatives.



  





**Pricing Platforms and Automation:** 



* Own the business roadmap for pricing engines, SAP pricing workflows and B2B contract pricing solutions.
* Partner with Technology and Data teams to define requirements and deliver competitor intelligence, predictive pricing, ticketing and workflow automation capabilities.
* Simplify price file processing, exception management, contract maintenance and data\-quality controls across retail and B2B channels.
* Establish appropriate testing, reconciliation and change controls for pricing system and process changes.
* Increase the proportion of pricing activity managed through automated, exception\-based workflows, releasing capacity for higher\-value analysis and decision support.
* Monitor platform performance, data integrity and user adoption, escalating material risks and control failures.



  





**Functional Leadership and Resource Management:**

 Company

 Kitchen / Central Kitchen

 Full\-Time
   


  

  




 About POPO Global
   

  

  


**POPO Global Private Limited**

 **43 outlets** 
 , with continued plans for expansion.
   





 As we continue to strengthen our central kitchen operations and maintain consistent food quality across our outlets, we are looking for an experienced and hands\-on
 **Executive Chef – Central Kitchen** 
 to lead central kitchen production, quality, cost control, food safety, team management and dispatch operations.
   

  




 Job Definition
   

  

  


 To organise, develop, operate and administer the Central Kitchen in accordance with company standards, approved recipes, SOPs and quality requirements, ensuring consistency, efficiency, hygiene and cost effectiveness across all production and dispatch activities.
   




 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Central Kitchen Operations
   

  

  

* Oversee the complete day\-to\-day operations of the Central Kitchen.
* Ensure all food products are prepared according to approved recipes, specifications and quality standards.
* Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion size and product quality across all outlets.
* Plan and monitor daily production based on outlet requirements and demand.
* Plan and coordinate timely dispatch of food products from the Central Kitchen to outlets.
* Ensure proper mise\-en\-place and production readiness across all kitchen stations.
* Develop and implement standard procedures for new tasks and changing operational requirements.


 Food Quality \& Recipe Management
   

  

  

* Take overall responsibility for food quality and quality assurance.
* Review and improve existing Central Kitchen recipes and production processes.
* Ensure all brand recipes, SOPs and specifications are consistently followed.
* Regularly review outlet feedback and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Maintain high attention to detail to ensure consistency and preserve food quality.


 Food Cost, Wastage \& Inventory Control
   

  

  

* Manage overall food cost without compromising product standards and quality.
* Monitor usage, consumption, spoilage and storage of food products.
* Implement effective wastage control measures at every stage of production.
* Identify opportunities to improve kitchen efficiency and reduce operational costs.
* Work closely with the Purchasing and Stores teams to optimise sourcing costs and raw material utilisation.
* Monitor inventory levels and ensure proper storage and handling of food products.


 Food Safety, Hygiene \& Sanitation
   

  

  

* Ensure the Central Kitchen maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene and sanitation.
* Ensure employees follow all company food safety and hygiene policies.
* Personally monitor appropriate cooking, thawing and storage temperatures for raw and cooked food.
* Ensure prescribed cleaning procedures and cleaning chemicals are used correctly.
* Coordinate pest control activities and ensure required standards are maintained.
* Ensure kitchen equipment and work areas are maintained in safe and hygienic condition.


 Team Management \& Development
   

  

  

* Lead, manage and monitor the Central Kitchen brigade.
* Participate in hiring and selection of kitchen team members.
* Train, coach and develop team members to meet operational and quality standards.

* Ensure team members follow company policies, SOPs and operational procedures.

 Coordination \& Management Reporting

* Strong Communication \& Interdepartmental Coordination
* Attention to Detail
* Leadership \& Team Motivation

 Candidate Requirements
   

* Proven experience as an
 **Executive Chef / Central Kitchen Chef / Head Chef** 
 in the Food \& Beverage or restaurant industry.
* Strong hands\-on experience in
 **Central Kitchen operations and large\-scale food production** 
 .
* Strong understanding of food cost, wastage control, inventory management and production planning.
* Experience in recipe standardisation and maintaining consistency across multiple outlets.
* Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene and sanitation standards.

 Preferred Qualifications

 **multi\-outlet restaurant or F\&B organisation** 
 .

 Benefits
   

  

 Benefits

 If you are an experienced culinary leader with strong expertise in

**Company Summary**
 DISH Network Technologies India Pvt. Ltd is a technology subsidiary of EchoStar. Our organization is at the forefront of technology, serving as a disruptive force and driving innovation and value on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 Our product portfolio includes Boost Mobile (consumer wireless), DISH TV (direct broadcast satellite), Sling TV (over\-the\-top service provider), Hughes (global satellite connectivity solutions) and Hughesnet (satellite internet).
   

  

 Our facilities in India are some of EchoStar's largest development centers outside the U.S. As a hub for technological convergence, our engineering talent is a catalyst for innovation in multimedia network and communications development.
   

  

 EchoStar does not charge any fees to job applicants or candidates at any point during the recruitment and hiring process. We strongly advise all individuals to be vigilant and disregard any unsolicited requests for payment or personal financial information related to an EchoStar employment opportunity.
   

  

 Department Summary
   

  

 Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our people play vital roles in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.
   

  

**Job Duties And Responsibilities**
 As part of the expanding InfoSec Center of Excellence at BTC, DISH is scaling its daily Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VA/PT) operations. The Lead / Staff Operational Security Engineer will serve as the operational backbone and technical authority for the vulnerability lifecycle. This role focuses on maintaining operational excellence across hybrid environments, leading response operations for critical threats, and acting as the primary operational bridge to software and platform teams—defining specific automation requirements and validating automated solutions to scale scanning, triage, and reporting operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Execution \& Vulnerability Lifecycle Management**
* Oversee and execute day\-to\-day VA/PT operational workflows across hybrid infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, and legacy data centers) to guarantee scanning coverage, accurate triage, and SLA enforcement.
* Lead operational response efforts for emergency vulnerabilities, zero\-day outbreaks, and active exploitation threats, coordinating war rooms and rapid mitigations across IT and Business units.
* Analyze complex vulnerabilities to eliminate false positives, evaluate real\-world exploitability, and establish strict prioritization using threat intelligence (CVE, CISA KEV, IOCs) and CVSS/SSVC metrics.
* Drive end\-to\-end remediation tracking with system, network, and application owners, maintaining tight oversight on vulnerability aging, SLAs, and exception/deferral workflows.
* Establish and monitor daily operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics, delivering actionable reports to operational leadership and audit teams.


**Automation Requirements \& Validation**
* Translate daily operational bottlenecks and manual testing workflows into actionable automation requirements for the InfoSec Engineering and DevOps teams.
* Establish test plans and rigorously validate all incoming automation initiatives, scripts, API integrations, and CI/CD security gates developed by engineering teams before production rollout.
* Define requirements for automated tool configuration, automated asset discovery, ticket creation workflows, and shift\-left scanning triggers to maximize operational throughput.


**People Leadership \& Operational Governance**
* Lead, direct, and mentor a high\-performing team of operational VA/PT analysts, establishing clear operational playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Manage day\-to\-day operational schedules, workload distribution, shift coverage, and ticket escalation queues.
* Oversee operational relationships with third\-party scanning vendors, external penetration testing teams.


**Skills, Experience And Requirements**
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**
* Operational \& Technical Expertise: Deep operational mastery of vulnerability scanning engines, threat intelligence feeds, manual verification techniques, and network/application infrastructure protocols.
* Automation Drive: Expert ability to analyze operational workflows, author technical requirement documents (PRDs/epics) for tool integration, and perform acceptance testing on delivered automated tools.
* Tooling Operations: Hands\-on operational administration of enterprise tools such as Qualys, Nessus, Synk, XSIAM, Invicti/Netsparker, Twistlock/Prisma Cloud, Metasploit, Burp Suite Pro, and ticketing platforms (Jira, ServiceNow).
* Frameworks \& Compliance: Strong operational application of NIST SP 800\-53, OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, and regulatory requirements (PCI\-DSS, ISO).
* Scripting Literacy: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to independently verify operational scripts, review automation code, and validate API behavior.


**Required Education, Certifications \& Experience**
* Experience: 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in security operations, vulnerability management, or penetration testing, including 3\+ years in an operational lead or supervisory capacity.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.

 We are seeking an experienced Team Leader for our Asset Management vertical to lead and develop our growing Asset Management capability within the Global Capability Centre (GCC). The role will provide line management, technical oversight, and project delivery support across a team of asset management professionals specialising in Integrity Management, Reliability Engineering, and Asset Advisory services.
   

  

 Working closely with the global Asset Management \& Advisory (AM\&A) leadership team, the successful candidate will be responsible for building team capability, managing resources, supporting project delivery, and driving the growth of asset management services across multiple sectors of the power industry, including thermal generation, transmission and distribution, hydro, wind, and solar.
   

  

 The role combines people leadership, technical excellence, project oversight, and business development support to ensure the GCC is recognised as a trusted delivery centre for global asset management projects.

* Oversee the technical quality and consistency of project deliverables produced by the GCC team.
* Support / lead delivery of asset management projects, including reliability studies, integrity assessments, asset health reviews, technical due diligence, and asset strategy development.
* Act as a senior point of contact between GCC teams and project managers across the wider AM\&A business.
* Identify capability gaps and implement training and development plans to strengthen technical expertise.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, standardisation of methodologies, and development of reusable tools and templates.
* Support proposal preparation, work\-winning activities, and capability development initiatives.
* Monitor utilisation, productivity, and team performance metrics.

title: Logistics & Freight Manager
description:
**About Origin**
 Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general\-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi\-trade platform combines purpose\-built hardware with real\-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high\-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%\+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent\-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Logistics \& Freight Manager will build and run Origin's global import and export operations to enable production as per the manufacturing plan and the movement of finished robots to live construction sites across the countries in Pipeline. The role owns end\-to\-end freight execution across air, ocean, and in\-land modes — inbound components, sub\-assemblies, and capital equipment from suppliers across India, China, Taiwan, South\-East Asia, the US, and Europe; outbound robots, spares, and RMA units to customer sites and overseas entities. It also owns the customs, documentation, and trade compliance layer beneath both flows, along with forwarder and customs\-broker management, freight rate negotiation, and freight spend. This role acts as the commercial and compliance bridge between Supply Chain, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Production, Finance, and the US deployment team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end import operations — shipment planning, booking, document validation, customs clearance, and final delivery to plant or warehouse — for components, sub\-assemblies, tooling, and capital equipment
* Own end\-to\-end export operations including shipping bill filing, certificates of origin, and destination\-specific certification for US and other markets
* Manage customs clearance through CHA partners — bill of entry filing, duty assessment, examination, out\-of\-charge — and drive clearance cycle time to under 3 days from document handover, with zero avoidable holds
* Own HS classification for all BOM items and finished goods; maintain a governed, auditable classification master and ensure correct duty determination (BCD, IGST, cess, anti\-dumping, FTA preferential rates with valid origin documentation)
* Maintain regulatory registrations and filings — IEC, AD Code registration at all working ports and ICDs, DGFT and ICEGATE transactions, licences and authorisations — and keep an audit\-ready record set for every consignment
* Evaluate and administer duty\-saving and deferment schemes — Advance Authorisation, EPCG, MOOWR bonded manufacturing, RoDTEP, duty drawback — and track benefit realised against entitlement
* Own dangerous goods movement for lithium\-ion battery packs and battery\-powered equipment — UN 38\.3 test summaries, IATA DGR and IMDG documentation, packing instructions, and DG\-certified forwarder selection
* Define export packaging and crating standards for high\-value, fragile, and oversized equipment — lashing, shock and tilt indicators, moisture protection — and drive zero transit damage on robot dispatches
* Build and manage the partner panel across all modes — 3\-5 evaluated freight forwarders, customs house agents, transporters, and courier partners per mode — through structured RFQs, rate benchmarking, and negotiated rate cards, contracts, and SLAs
* Drive freight cost optimization (15\-20% opportunity) through consolidation, mode shift, lane redesign, packaging optimization, and duty\-scheme utilization, with savings quantified and validated with Finance
* Maintain a live shipment tracker, lead\-time master, and logistics risk dashboard — lane, port, carrier, regulatory, and geopolitical exposure — with alternate routing and backup partners identified for every critical lane
* Implement forwarder and CHA performance scorecards (on\-time performance, clearance turnaround, documentation accuracy, damage rate, billing hygiene) and run quarterly business reviews
* Manage cargo insurance coverage and drive damage, shortage, and loss claims to closure
* Write and maintain SOPs, escalation matrices, and checklists; support the scale\-up to 200 units per year without logistics appearing as a cause of build or deployment schedule slip


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or a related field
* 4\-8 years of experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or shipper\-side EXIM operations
* Hands\-on ownership of both import and export operations — not one side only — with demonstrated experience across all three modes: air, ocean, and in\-land freight
* Strong working knowledge of Indian customs procedure and documentation — bill of entry and shipping bill filing, HS classification, duty structure, ICEGATE, and Incoterms 2020
* Proven track record of negotiating freight rates and managing forwarder, CHA, and transporter relationships across multiple lanes
* Hands\-on global lane exposure (mandatory exposure beyond India — China and US preferred)
* Working knowledge of trade compliance obligations — licences, registrations, product certification, and audit requirements
* Ability to build and defend a freight and landed\-cost model in Excel or Google Sheets, and to run the function from data rather than instinct
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to escalate and negotiate with carriers, brokers, and customs authorities


**Preferred Experience**
* Previous experience in logistics or EXIM at Automobiles, Electric Vehicles, Automation, Industrial Equipment, Capital Goods, Robotics, Drones, or Aerospace organizations
* Experience shipping dangerous goods, particularly lithium\-ion batteries, and handling over\-dimensional or high\-value cargo
* Familiarity with duty\-saving and bonded schemes — MOOWR, EPCG, Advance Authorisation, SEZ, or FTWZ operations
* Exposure to China, Taiwan, South\-East Asia, US, and EU trade lanes and their supplier ecosystems
* Exposure to ERP or logistics management systems (SAP, Oracle, Zoho, Odoo, Tally) and shipment visibility platforms
* Certification such as CHA, IATA DGR, CSCP, or an equivalent trade\-compliance qualification
* Comfortable with low\-volume / high\-mix shipping rhythm and startup environments where the process has to be built, not inherited


**Preferred Skills**
* Freight rate benchmarking and negotiation
* Customs documentation and HS classification
* Multi\-modal routing and mode\-shift analysis
* Trade compliance and duty\-scheme management
* Dangerous goods and export packaging standards
* Landed\-cost and freight spend modeling
* Logistics risk management and contingency planning
* Vendor score carding and quarterly business reviews
* Strong Excel and data management skills

title: IAM Operations - Operation Readiness
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IAM OPERATIONAL SERVICE \- Business Engagement and Management**
 Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.
   

  

 Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security\-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, a part of Information Security which enables over 330,000 individuals across 140\+ countries to access systems and information securely. As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for, a complex Active Directory (AD) environment, hybrid cloud deployment, mobile computing, policy driven security, SSO, user provisioning/de\-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML, OpenID, Azure AD)
   

  

 We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career receiving support, coaching and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role will give you an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!
   

  

**The IAM Operations Service Manager** 
 is responsible for driving global consistency, operational readiness, and continuous improvement across IAM Operational Services (services delivered by IAM Operations).
   

  

 This role acts as a central coordination and business engagement point across IAM Operations domains (Identity, Group/Directory Services, and Infrastructure), ensuring:
   

  

* IAM Operational Services are standardized, scalable, and aligned globally
* New technologies are operationally ready for production within IAM Operations
* Transitions into operations are structured, controlled, and aligned to ITIL practice
* Continuous improvement is driven through feedback, metrics, and governance


 The role facilitates and coordinates across teams, rather than owning technical delivery or full\-service lifecycle accountability.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Global IAM Operational Services Alignment \& Process Standardization**
* Align IAM Operations processes into a consistent global delivery model
* Identify and incorporate regional or country\-specific nuances
* Maintain standardized processes, policies, and documentation
* Ensure consistency across Identity, Group Management, and Infrastructure


**Operational Readiness \& Transition Management**
* Establish and maintain Operational Readiness and Transition frameworks
* Define readiness scope, success criteria, and transition requirements
* Coordinate onboarding of new IAM technologies into operations
* Capture and validate operational requirements before service acceptance
* Facilitate readiness reviews and signoff processes with technical leads


**Service Improvement, Intake \& Governance**
* Coordinate intake and prioritization of service improvement initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement based on post\-implementation insights
* Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and enhancements


**BAU Support Enablement \& Service Performance Facilitation**
* Support service performance monitoring with Service Owners
* Collect and communicate user feedback
* Identify and escalate operational issues
* Analyze tool performance and identify improvements


**Governance, Compliance \& Standards**
* Review and confirm that changes and enhancements to IAM Operational Services align with established IAM business rules, governance requirements, and operational standards
* Ensure all updates are consistent, compliant, and maintain global alignment across IAM Operations
* Document and communicate any required changes to IAM policies, procedures, or supporting tools to reflect updates and maintain consistency
* Ensure self\-service support resources and knowledge materials are established, kept up to date, and are globally accessible to support IAM Operational Services delivery


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Cross\-Team Coordination**
* Act as liaison between IAM Operations, Infrastructure, Solutions teams, and users
* Communicate service changes and operational impacts


**Testing, Implementation \& Change Enablement**
* Coordinate IAM Operations UAT and rollout activities
* Support test plan development


**Monitoring, Stability \& Operational Health**
* Coordinate and facilitate the establishment of monitoring and reporting mechanisms to support the stability of IAM Operational Services
* Ensure appropriate reporting and analytics capabilities are defined, available, and aligned to support Service Owners and operational teams
* Coordinate and support problem management activities by ensuring issues are routed, tracked, and addressed through the appropriate teams
* Enable continuous service stabilization by facilitating cross\-team discussions, follow\-ups, and alignment on remediation actions


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities to assess complex IAM Operational Services challenges, identify root causes, and recommend solutions that are operationally feasible and aligned with business priorities
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple and shifting priorities across a globally distributed environment, balancing operational needs with long\-term improvement objectives
* Advanced critical thinking skills to evaluate current processes, identify gaps, and drive improvements that maintain service continuity, minimize risk, and enhance user experience
* Strong consultative and facilitation skills, with the ability to guide discussions, challenge constructively, and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders


**Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership across geographies
* Ability to adapt communication style to diverse audiences, present complex concepts clearly, and support decision\-making through structured insights and recommendations
* Proven ability to build and maintain strong working relationships across IAM Operations, Infrastructure, and partner teams to enable collaboration and knowledge sharing
* Confidence in facilitating cross\-team discussions, escalating issues appropriately, and influencing outcomes without direct authority


**Operational \& Service Management Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM Operational Services delivery, including identity lifecycle processes, provisioning, access management, and operational support models
* Experience in defining and improving operational readiness, transition frameworks, and service improvement processes
* Familiarity with ITIL principles and their application in service transition, change management, problem management, and continuous improvement
* Ability to drive operational consistency through standardized processes, governance, and global alignment


**Technical Knowledge**
* Working knowledge of IAM technologies and infrastructure, including:
+ Active Directory services (AD DS, AD FS, AD CS, etc.)
+ Identity governance and provisioning tools (e.g., SailPoint, etc.)
+ Federation, PKI, authentication, and directory services platforms

* Broad understanding of enterprise IT environments to assess the impact of changes, connectivity considerations, and dependencies across systems
* Familiarity with service management and knowledge\-sharing tools (e.g., knowledge bases, collaboration platforms) to enable consistent operational delivery


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of experience in IAM Operations, IT infrastructure, or service management within a large, complex enterprise environment
* Proven experience supporting or enabling:
+ IAM Operational Services delivery
+ Operational readiness and service transitions
+ Continuous improvement and process optimization initiatives

* Experience working across multiple regions and teams, with an understanding of global operational challenges and requirements


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* ITIL Foundation (or equivalent service management certification)
* Relevant Microsoft or IAM\-related certifications (e.g., identity, directory, or infrastructure technologies)


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a highly collaborative and analytical IAM professional who can operate effectively in a global, cross\-functional environment to drive alignment, operational readiness, and continuous improvement across IAM Operational Services. The ideal candidate brings strong facilitation, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to influence outcomes, coordinate across multiple teams, and translate complex operational needs into structured, scalable processes. A proactive mindset, combined with experience in IAM operations and infrastructure, is key to enabling consistent, high\-quality service delivery and ongoing optimization.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
