title: Senior Manager-Operations & Customer Experience
description:
**About Company:** 




 Blissclub is one of India’s fastest\-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community\-first D2C brand has expanded into experience\-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.
 



 Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre\-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.
 



 Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest\-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.
 



  





**Job Location** 
 : HSR Layout, Bangalore (on\-site)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're hiring a Senior Manager Operations \& Customer Experience: someone who can hold two things at once the rigour to run tight backend operations, and the empathy to obsess over every customer interaction.This role spans two interconnected charters. First, you'll own the operational engine that powers BlissClub's fulfillment warehousing, logistics, and systems across D2C, retail, and marketplaces. Second, and equally important, you'll own the end\-to\-end Customer Experience from the moment someone lands on our website or walks into a store, to what happens after they've placed an order, received it, and reached out for help.You'll work directly with the founding and leadership team as a strategic thought partner helping shape how BlissClub scales intelligently, not just fast. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, builds for the long term, and holds themselves accountable to measurable outcomes.
 



  





**Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Strategy \& Fulfillment** 



* Manage warehouse operations end\-to\-end: inventory accuracy, replenishment planning, ageing, and loss prevention across channels.
* Optimize dispatch and logistics across D2C, marketplaces, retail, and quick commerce managing SLAs, reducing RTOs, and improving delivery TATs through strong vendor partnerships.
* Ensure seamless order flow, packaging standards, and post\-order experience across all fulfillment formats.
* Lead sourcing and procurement for packaging and operational materials.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sourcing, Finance, Category, and Growth on demand planning and cost control.



  





**Customer Experience** 



* Own BlissClub's end\-to\-end customer experience across our website, retail stores, and all post\-purchase touchpoints with customer NPS as your north star metric.
* Design and implement the CX strategy: mapping the full customer journey, identifying friction points, and building interventions that measurably improve satisfaction and loyalty.
* Lead and scale the customer support function building team capacity, processes, and tooling to handle growing query volumes across channels (email, chat, social, in\-store).
* Own the voice of the customer inside BlissClub: synthesize support data, CSAT signals, return patterns, and NPS feedback into actionable insights for product, marketing, and ops teams.
* Define and track CX metrics across the funnel from pre\-purchase (website and store experience) to post\-purchase (delivery, returns, support).



  





**Qualifications** 



* 7–10 years of experience, with meaningful time in consumer brands D2C, retail, or both. You've run operations
 *and* 
 thought seriously about customer experience, not just one or the other.
* Strong analytical ability: comfortable building frameworks, working with data, and translating insight into action.
* Experience with multi\-channel fulfilment including Q\-commerce, retail, and marketplaces.
* A deep understanding of inventory systems, warehousing workflows, and logistics SLAs. You should be adept at optimizing these processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Experience leading cross\-functional work you know how to align teams around a shared goal without formal authority.
* A founder mindset: you don't wait to be asked, you don't hand problems upward, and you raise the standard of whatever you touch.
* Excellent communication written and verbal. You can present a strategic recommendation as clearly as you can write a customer\-facing SOP.



  





**Why Join Blissclub** 



* A seat at the table: you'll work directly with the founding team and have genuine influence over how this company is built.
* Real ownership: this role shapes Blissclub's operational future you'll see the impact of your decisions every day.
* Competitive compensation and ESOPs.
* A brand people love, a product that's genuinely differentiated, and a team that cares deeply about doing things right.
* The chance to build something meaningful for a community of women who show up for themselves every day.



  






 https://blissclub.com/

title: Senior Manager - Operations || Bangalore || upto 30 LPA
description:
**About the Role**




 You will own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of our AI\-powered inspection projects — from technical scoping through installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and handover. You will lead a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers, and you will be the person our Fortune 500 customers rely on to get their line running. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will be in the detail on project plans, SLAs, and escalations, and you will also be building the systems and standards that let us scale from 30 parallel projects to many more without adding chaos. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, Product and Engineering, and the Sales team.
 



  





**Project Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of projects — scoping, timelines, installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and customer handover.
 



 • Deliver projects on time and within budget, and hold the team to the same standard.
 



 • Track and manage timelines and deliverables across technical verticals; anticipate slippage before it happens rather than reporting it afterwards.
 



 • Own Response and Resolution SLAs across queues coming in from Product, Sales, and customers, and ensure optimal work distribution.
 



 • Run root\-cause analysis on delays and rework, and close the loop so the same failure does not repeat.
 



  





**Technical Excellence** 




 • Translate new requirements from Account Executives and customers into clear scope, technical requirements, and realistic timelines.
 



 • Drive delivery of deep\-tech projects (AI / ML / Computer Vision) with a hardware and software footprint on live production lines.
 



 • Represent Operations in project discussions and client calls — identify the exact technical deliverable, communicate it clearly to the technical team, and drive it to completion.
 



 • Continuously improve efficiency metrics: productivity, quality, first\-time\-right installation, and SLA adherence.
 



 • Partner with Product and Engineering to feed structured field learnings back into the roadmap.
 



  





**Customer Delight** 




 • Own the relationship with client SPOCs through proactive communication and disciplined review cadence.
 



 • Make sure what was agreed during the sales process is exactly what gets delivered — and that we consistently over\-deliver.
 



 • Align with the customer's own KPIs and drive improvement initiatives after the system goes live.
 



 • Handle escalations and outages calmly and decisively — with the customer, and on the customer's behalf with third\-party vendors.
 



 • Communicate credibly with plant leadership and senior stakeholders at Fortune 500 manufacturers.
 



  





**Planning \& Resource Management** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day planning, allocation, and problem\-solving across a distributed field team.
 



 • Own resource planning: who goes where, when, and for how long — balancing project urgency against team wellbeing.
 



 • Track work hours and utilisation, and make the case for additional capacity with data when it is genuinely needed.
 



 • Manage project costs, travel, and hardware logistics in coordination with Finance and Supply Chain
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers.
 



 • Hire FAEs as our project count and geographic footprint expand — we look for technically stellar and deeply empathetic people.
 



 • Build a high\-performance environment that people want to stay in; our Operations team is one of the most driven teams at SwitchOn and keeping it that way is part of the job.
 



 • Run regular one\-on\-ones and team meetings, surface issues early, and resolve conflict directly and fairly.
 



 • Present team performance honestly to the Head of Operations and senior leadership — including what is not working.
 



  





**Systems, Data \& Reporting** 




 • Maintain accurate records of execution time, delays, and root causes so that leadership can make data\-driven decisions.
 



 • Own operational hygiene in our tooling (JIRA / Asana / Zoho) as a source of truth, not an afterthought.
 



 • Build and improve the SOPs, checklists, and playbooks that let a new FAE deliver to standard from their first site visit.

title: Manager, Supply Chain
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
   

  

 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
   

  

 In this role, the Supply Chain Manager manages the supply chain team—driving procurement execution, material planning, and supplier performance to ensure on\-time delivery, inventory optimization, and system efficiency, while developing people capabilities that support Armstrong’s operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Analytical Thinking
   

  

* Forecasting demand and planning capacity while balancing cost, speed, and risk
* Making data\-driven decisions using KPIs (inventory turnover, fill rate, lead time, OTIF)
* Seeing the end\-to\-end flow — not just their own link in the chain
* Adjusting to market shifts, tariffs, or supply shocks
* Driving continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma mindset)Financial Acumen
* Understanding cost structures — procurement, warehousing, transportation, inventory carrying costs
* Making trade\-off decisions that protect margins without hurting service levels


 Ensure On\-Time Delivery (OTD) and Procurement Execution
   

  

* Drive on\-time delivery (OTD) as a top\-level KPI, aiming for high performance across all suppliers and value streams.
* Oversee timely procurement by ensuring buyers act on purchase requisitions promptly and in correct quantities \& Focus on LT on deliveries
* Conduct daily shortage and backlog reviews with planners and buyers to ensure a continuous flow of production orders.
* Lead a daily cadence meeting with the entire buyer\-planner team to review order releases, past dues (quantity and dollar value), and commodity\-specific challenges.
* Monitor and support adherence to consignment agreements for critical parts such as castings and impellers sourced through partners like the Regional Supply Chain team.


 Lead Material Planning and Inventory Optimization
   

  

* Review Material Requirement Planning (MRP) signals regularly and coordinate material fulfillment by collaborating with suppliers and aggregating demand when feasible.
* Coordinate closely with global demand planners to align inventory and safety stock levels with forecasts.
* Optimize safety stock strategies, drive inventory turnover improvements, and enforce just\-in\-time (JIT) principles across Armstrong facilities and supplier sites.
* Lead efforts to improve forecasting precision and production order releases with internal planners, ensuring readiness aligned with capacity and customer expectations.
* Have CFT approach on new product launches and enhance material procurement plans accordingly.


 Monitor and Improve Supply Chain Performance
   

  

* Develop and sustain delivery performance tracking systems using the PDCA (Plan\-Do\-Check\-Act) methodology to drive continuous improvement.
* Track and analyze key supply chain metrics such as lead times, order handling cycle times, and fill rates to enhance operational performance.
* Collaborate with customer service and sales teams to improve lead times and streamline the quote\-to\-fulfill cycle.
* Monitor global trends, disruptions, and risks to adapt supply chain strategies using tools like dual sourcing, supplier localization, and logistics optimization.


 Strengthen Supplier Management and Accountability
   

  

* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships through regular performance reviews, scorecards, and compliance checks.
* Conduct supplier audits and implement continuous improvement initiatives based on audit findings and operational KPIs.
* Collaborate with sourcing and supplier teams to proactively assess capacity constraints and implement delivery assurance strategies.
* Structure and assign supplier ownership clearly among buyers and planners by value streams, reducing overlap and improving accountability.
* Enforce ISO\-compliant procedures for purchasing and planning functions to maintain quality and process integrity.


 Lead and Develop Buyer\-Planner Teams
   

  

* Supervise a team of buyer/planners categorized by product families and value streams.
* Clarify ownership of supplier portfolios by aligning responsibilities to specific value streams, reducing overlap and improving accountability.
* Drive transformation initiatives to realign team structure for better performance tracking and supplier relationship management.
* Conduct coaching, training, and performance reviews to build capability in ERP tools and supply chain analytics.
* Provide mentorship and day\-to\-day guidance to buyer\-planners to improve performance and ownership.


 Implement and Optimize Supply Chain Systems
   

  

* Lead the implementation of Kinaxis for advanced planning capabilities, guiding cross\-functional teams through integration and change management.
* Monitor and correct LN ERP workflows and master data issues to ensure planning and execution systems are synchronized.
* Automate routine supply chain tasks and enhance system capabilities to improve forecast accuracy, planning responsiveness, and operational agility.
* Ensure that all systems are aligned to support dynamic planning requirements and real\-time visibility into supply performance.


 Integrate Supply Chain in New Products, Projects, and Regions
   

  

* Collaborate with engineering, sales, and program teams to support new product introductions (NPIs), phase\-outs, and engineering change orders.
* Lead supply chain integration for new regional markets and strategic projects, ensuring timely sourcing, logistics setup, and compliance alignment.
* Participate in SIOP (Sales, Inventory \& Operations Planning) processes with commercial teams to align inventory and demand.
* Streamline and optimize the New Change Process (NCP) to improve supply chain responsiveness to product lifecycle changes.


 People Management
   

  

* Coaching and motivating warehouse, procurement, and logistics staff
* Delegating effectively across multiple sites or shifts
* Conflict resolution between departments (e.g., sales wants more stock, finance wants less)
* Building long\-term supplier partnerships, not just transactional deals
* Managing multiple stakeholders — internal teams, 3PLs, customers, regulators


 Problem\-Solving Under Pressure
   

  

* Handling disruptions (supplier delays, demand spikes, logistics failures) quickly and calmly
* Root\-cause analysis rather than just firefighting
* Building contingency plans and backup supplier networks


 Communication \& Negotiation
   

  

* Negotiating pricing, terms, and SLAs with vendors and suppliers
* Translating operational issues into business language for senior leadership
* Aligning sales, procurement, warehousing, and finance teams who often have conflicting priorities


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

**To Thrive In This Role, You Should Bring**
 Education and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree Mechanical/Electrical/industrial engineering or Masters in business administration, supply chain management, operations management shall be an additional advantage.
* 10\-15 years of demonstrated experience in supply chain, procurement and logistics functions in a configured manufacturing environment.
* Preferred to have the following:
* APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
* Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM)
* Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) – from ISM
* Prior experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, ideally LN or similar such as SAP, CMS etc.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced data organization and analytics capabilities in Excel and Power BI.
* Exposure to supply chain planning platform like Kinaxis.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Excellent understanding of materials planning and inventory management principles.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and experience in implementing process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of cost reduction and supply optimization initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies is considered an asset
* Knowledge of commodity costing \& rich supplier Base locally/globally.
* Good understanding on Manufacturing processes.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Demonstrated success in leadership experience managing teams or cross\-functional projects
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis.
* Capability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, suppliers and team members.


 Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?
   

  

 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Spa Manager
description:

 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work!  A passion for spreading the light and warmth of

 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership**

 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now**

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

description:

title: Manager- ETD & Commodities
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure that all client and house trades are cleared and settled in a timely manner and adhere to bank and exchange policy.
* Monitor and pay the client and house margin calls in line with the rules of the exchange and settle all client and house queries in line with policy.
* High levels of engagement with stakeholders are needed to optimise current processes in order to make sure the department runs as efficiently as possible.
* As ETD (Exchange Traded Derivatives) Operations Associate you would also be expected to lead and take a proactive stance on new initiatives and projects to drive the business forward and work closely with the LME, ICE \& CME Exchanges to deliver new market services to SCB.
* This is a key hire into the India ETD Operations team to deliver the operational requirements of Self Clearing to support the CME and ICE Clearing operations activities and other exchanges as required/ onboarded.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting, settlement and reconciliation of Platinum Group Metals (PGM) VAT for SCB UK deliveries of Rhodium, Ruthenium and Iridium.


**Business**
* Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) Technology, Transformation \& Operations (TTO) has a dedicated Financial Market Operations which supports the market clients and products within Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB).
* FM Operations has responsibility for the execution, control and continuous improvement of processes to support our Products \& Clients. FMO has 3 distinct functions – Product Management, Regional/Country oversight and Processing Functions (Service Providers).
* This role has oversight for product management of Financial Market Commodity Operations including Futures, Listed and OTC Derivatives and Physical Commodities.


**Processes**
* Maintenance of brokers, contracts, accounts in the banks systems to ensure STP trade flow
* Top Day Trade Monitoring and allocations for ICE Group, CME Group (NYMEX, COMEX, CBOT) and LME and other exchanges as required/ onboarded
* Monitoring Lifecyle events on TAS trades
* Trade and Position Reconciliation
* Front Office – Back Office (FOBO) Reconciliations
* Open interest management
* Managing intra\-day cash margin calls
* Option Abandonment/Exercise
* MIFID II CPR Position Reporting and CME/ CFTC Large Trader (Position Reporting) to the relevant exchanges
* CME FX Delivery Process
* COMEX Physical deliveries (Warrants)
* Platinum Group Metals VAT Invoicing, Payables and Receivables and Reconciliations for Rhodium, Ruthenium and Iridium. Face\-off to clients and suppliers and ensure timely and accurate incoming and outgoing VAT reporting and payments for the SCB UK entity and others as required/ onboarded.


**People \& Talent**
* Ensure that there is a strong support model and staff contingency plan in place within the team at all times.
* Enhance the development of peers by imparting knowledge in your area of expertise.
* Work in collaboration with risk and control partners


**Risk Management**

* Ensure operational risk/loss incidents are logged and managed in accordance to group OR procedures.
* Ensure a full understanding of the risk and control environment in area of responsibility


**Governance**

* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Willingness to work with any local regulators/exchange in an open and cooperative manner.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Help the ETD Operations team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Comply with all regulation including, CASS, EMIR, Dodd Frank, client identification, KYC and apply relevant AML procedures and all reporting as necessary.


**Key stakeholders**
* Work in close synergy with the global ETD Clearing teams in London, US and Kuala Lumpur and Middle Office in London, Singapore, US and India to resolve daily BAU issues and ensure processes are executed efficiently.
* Support the trading desks by being responsive to any questions and challenge when necessary.
* Work closely with Country and Group Operational Risk Functions to address control gaps or process weaknesses.
* Support the Global Head of Commodities and ETD Operations and the COO office to execute the strategy of the FM Business.
* Support both country and product compliance to ensure the function is compliant to all regulatory and exchange requirements.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the ETD Operations team,
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


**Skills And Experience**
* Internal Controls
* Operational Functions
* Products and Services
* Relationship Management
* Risk Management

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* University degree preferred
* Languages: English


**Required Experience**

* ETD trade, position and cash reconciliations inclusive of fees \& commission management
* Additional knowledge of expiry and trade life\-cycling is highly desirable
* Minimum 3 years Financial Markets experience ideally from a top tier bank
* Understanding of front to back process and systems flows
* Strong understanding of commodities products including Base Metals, Precious Metals, Structured Inventory Product, Energy, Power \& Gas. Financial and physical knowledge needed and highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of Carbon Emissions and Voluntary Carbon Credits and experience of ICE Endex and CBL exchanges desirable.

* Strong inter\-personal skills
* Confident communicator able to adapt style to Front Office and Hubs colleagues
* Ability to influence demanding individuals
* Demonstrate strong teamwork and values mindset
* Thrive on working in fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail
* Fast learner with the ability to think out of the box and provide solutions
* Knowledge of vendor systems supporting ETDs (ION XTP, FIS, GMI or equivalent) Bloomberg, Murex v2\.11 and v3\.1 preferable plus LME SMART, LME SELECT, ICE Admin, ICE FEC, ICE ECS, CME Deliveries Plus, CME FEC

If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you.  Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

title: Account Manager- South
description:
Lead the safe, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective operation and maintenance of multiple industrial water and wastewater treatment sites. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for plant performance, contractual KPIs, customer satisfaction, workforce capability, maintenance systems, budgets, vendors, statutory compliance and continuous improvement across the assigned portfolio.
 



 The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership to site managers and multidisciplinary teams, standardize O\&M practices across locations, and ensure timely resolution of critical operational and customer issues.
 



 2\. Scope of Responsibility
 


* Oversee multiple O\&M contracts and treatment facilities operating on a continuous shift basis.
* Provide governance and technical direction for WTP, ETP, STP, RO and ZLD facilities, including associated pumping, clarification, filtration, sludge handling, evaporation and drying systems.
* Manage mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation and process performance through site teams and specialist support functions.
* Own service delivery in line with contract terms, agreed budgets, customer specifications, environmental requirements and internal standards.



 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Multi\-Site Operations \& Performance
 


* Take overall ownership of day\-to\-day O\&M performance across all assigned sites and ensure uninterrupted availability of critical water systems.
* Review plant operating parameters, water quality, throughput, recovery, uptime and consumption trends; initiate corrective action for deviations.
* Conduct structured site reviews and risk\-based visits, with focused support for underperforming or critical facilities.
* Coordinate rapid technical support for breakdowns, chronic problems and process upsets to minimize downtime and customer production impact.
* Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, reliability improvement and operating\-cost reduction without compromising safety, quality or compliance.
* Ensure effective shift deployment, escalation protocols and management coverage across sites.



 B. Treatment Process \& Technical Oversight
 


* Provide technical governance for raw\-water treatment, clarification, filtration, cooling\-water systems, ETP, STP, RO, UF/NF where applicable, MEE, ATFD, filter press, clarifier, thickener, oil skimmer and complete ZLD systems.
* Monitor influent and effluent quality, RO recovery and rejection, membrane performance, chemical dosing, sludge generation, evaporation efficiency and final discharge or reuse quality.
* Guide root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and automation issues.
* Ensure calibration and documentation of instruments, gauges and measuring devices as per schedule and audit requirements.
* Maintain current technical knowledge and promote adoption of proven operating and maintenance practices.



 C. Maintenance \& Reliability
 


* Establish and govern preventive, predictive, condition\-based, time\-based and breakdown maintenance programs.
* Ensure maintenance planning, work\-order discipline, shutdown planning, spares management and equipment\-history records are effective at every site.
* Review critical equipment health for pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, dosing systems, dewatering equipment, membranes, evaporators, dryers, MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA and field instruments.
* Lead failure investigations, root\-cause analysis and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive equipment reliability, reduced repeat failures and optimized maintenance cost.



 D. Safety, Environment \& Compliance
 


* Be accountable for a goal\-zero safety culture across the assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with HSE/EHS requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, SOPs, risk assessments, PPE, chemical handling, lockout/tagout and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental events are reported, investigated and closed with effective corrective actions.
* Conduct and monitor safety audits, toolbox talks, hazard\-register reviews and statutory inspections.
* Maintain environmental, legal and customer compliance records in audit\-ready condition.



 E. Contract, KPI \& Customer Management
 


* Establish and review site KPIs in line with contract requirements, including plant availability, water quality, throughput, recovery, downtime, consumption, cost, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare consolidated monthly MIS, performance dashboards, variance analysis and recovery plans for management and customer reviews.
* Lead customer meetings, technical discussions and escalation management; ensure timely closure of observations and commitments.
* Protect contractual performance and billing by ensuring KPI evidence, service records, approvals and monthly documentation are complete and timely.
* Identify contract risks, scope gaps and change requirements, and escalate them with clear technical and commercial justification.



 F. Budget, Cost \& Commercial Control
 


* Prepare and manage annual and monthly O\&M budgets for the assigned portfolio.
* Monitor actual expenditure against budget and control manpower, chemicals, energy, spares, maintenance and subcontracting costs.
* Develop savings initiatives through process optimization, chemical and energy reduction, improved reliability and resource productivity.
* Plan critical spares, consumables, annual maintenance and shutdown requirements based on operational risk and contract obligations.
* Support timely customer billing, certification and resolution of performance\-linked deductions or commercial issues.



 G. Team Leadership \& Capability Building
 


* Lead site managers, engineers, supervisors, technicians, operators and support teams across locations.
* Define accountability, review staffing and shift structures, and ensure deployment matches plant criticality and skill needs.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, train and develop site teams; maintain skill matrices and succession plans for critical roles.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct structured reviews, while promoting discipline, ownership and collaboration.
* Ensure technically competent manpower is available to troubleshoot critical equipment and process issues.



 H. Systems, Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Standardize SOPs, checklists, log sheets, maintenance practices, reporting formats and escalation mechanisms across sites.
* Ensure critical work instructions are practical, pictorial and available in a language understood by the workforce where required.
* Use performance data to identify systemic issues, benchmark sites and replicate best practices.
* Coordinate effectively with Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, HR, Finance and corporate support functions.
* Promote digital tools such as CMMS/SAP, dashboards and MS Office applications for planning, documentation and performance control.



 4\. Key Performance Indicators
 



**KPI Area** 




**Measures** 




**Safety \& Compliance** 




 Zero injuries; closure of audit findings; statutory and environmental compliance
 



**Plant Performance** 




 Availability, uptime, throughput, treated\-water quality and adherence to operating targets
 



**Process Efficiency** 




 Recovery, chemical consumption, energy consumption, water reuse and sludge or reject management
 



**Reliability** 




 Breakdown frequency, repeat failures, preventive\-maintenance compliance and downtime
 



**Commercial** 




 Budget adherence, cost savings, billing documentation and reduction of performance deductions
 



**Customer** 




 Satisfaction, escalation closure, review effectiveness and completion of commitments
 



**People** 




 Manpower productivity, training completion, skill coverage and retention of critical capability
 



 5\. Qualification \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental or a related engineering discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant O\&M experience, preferably in industrial water and wastewater treatment, utilities, heavy industry, metals, chemicals or similar process industries.
* Proven experience managing multiple sites, large contracts or a geographically distributed O\&M portfolio.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to water and wastewater treatment and ZLD operations, together with multidisciplinary maintenance management.
* Experience in customer\-facing roles, budgeting, vendor management, workforce leadership, KPI governance and management reporting.



 6\. Required Technical Knowledge
 


* Water treatment processes: clarification, filtration, disinfection, demineralization and membrane systems.
* Wastewater and reuse systems: ETP, STP, RO, sludge handling and ZLD, including MEE and ATFD where applicable.
* Mechanical systems: pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, valves, piping and rotating equipment.
* Electrical and instrumentation: HT/LT interfaces, MCC/PCC, VFDs, PLC/SCADA, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, interlocks and calibration.
* Maintenance systems: preventive, predictive, condition\-based and breakdown maintenance; root\-cause analysis; spares planning.
* HSE, environmental compliance, statutory requirements, quality systems and audit documentation.
* Working knowledge of CMMS/SAP, MS Office and data\-based reporting tools.



 7\. Leadership Competencies
 


* Ownership and accountability across multiple operating locations.
* Strong planning, prioritization and decision\-making under operational pressure.
* Customer orientation with confident technical and commercial communication.
* Analytical problem\-solving and disciplined closure of corrective actions.
* Ability to coach teams, build trust and create a safety\-focused performance culture.
* Effective cross\-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel frequently.



 8\. Decision\-Making Authority
 


* Operational decisions required to protect safety, compliance, equipment and continuity of service.
* Deployment of manpower and resources within the approved organization structure and budget.
* Prioritization of maintenance, spares and technical support based on plant criticality.
* Vendor and service\-provider recommendations in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalation of contractual, commercial, safety and compliance risks to appropriate management.



 9\. Candidate Profile
 



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented O\&M leader who can manage a diverse portfolio of water and wastewater treatment plants, strengthen site leadership, build reliable operating systems and maintain strong customer confidence. The candidate should combine process knowledge with maintenance discipline, commercial awareness, people leadership and an uncompromising approach to safety and compliance.

**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
 Stellantis is reinventing the future of mobility by establishing a next\-generation global Software Engineering organization (SWE). As part of this transformation, the SWEO/SCPO team is driving simplification, governance, and digital enablement of global procurement operations.
   

  

 We are seeking a Global Procurement Process Lead to own the end\-to\-end Procurement Intake → Contract → PR → PO process and the enabling digital tools (e.g., SPEND, SWORD, dashboards). This role is accountable for how procurement work flows globally, ensuring clarity, compliance, scalability, and continuous improvement across all regions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Process Ownership \& Governance
   

  

* Own and manage a global procurement process that centralizes data \& communication related to Statements of Work, Contract Management, Sourcing, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Delivery and invoicing within various SAP systems in every region.
* Define and maintain process scope, ownership, handoffs, and decision rights across regions.
* Establish and enforce global governance standards, ensuring compliance with purchasing policies, audit requirements, and financial controls. Communicate changes and governance decisions clearly.
* Act as the final escalation point for process\-related issues.
* Partner with Global Purchasing, Finance, Legal, ICT, and SWE Domain leadership.
* Drive automation and system integration opportunities.
* Champion user\-centric design and simplification.


**Tool Ownership \& Enablement**
* Serve as Business Owner for procurement tools and platforms (e.g., SPEND, SWORD, reporting tools).
* Define tool requirements including fields, validations, workflows, statuses, and integrations.
* Prioritize enhancements focused on simplification and automation.
* Ensure tools reflect the current global process, not legacy practices.
* Define and own global procurement KPIs.
* Ensure availability and accuracy of dashboards and reports.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Be an expert in the Global Procurement Process and coach SWE Domains on the process and procurement requirements
* Ensure processes are scalable, repeatable, and audit\-ready.
* Maintain RASCI models and process documentation.
* Support training and change management.
* Process adaptation during org restructures and operating model changes
* Impact assessment and transition without execution or compliance disruption
* Internal and external benchmarking against peers and best practices
* Conducting and Using benchmark insights to drive simplification and maturity improvements
* Embedding lessons learned into standard processes, tools, and governance


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related discipline
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience that includes 5 years’ experience in leading the Procurement Operations or Global Process Ownership roles
* Possess strong problem\-solving skills with customer centric approach, multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment, and ability to work with diverse Global teams
* Ability to define metrics and quantify business value
* Highly Self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented mindset
* Proven experience owning global processes and enterprise tools
* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP (requisition creation, PO management, approvals)
* High proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams) and collaboration platforms


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in global, matrixed organizations.
* Strong understanding of procurement, finance, and compliance interactions.
* Experience with automation and digital transformation initiatives.
* Advanced experience using workflow management, and reporting.
* Prior experience in Project Management or Business Finance functions.
* Experience working in an automotive OEM or large global enterprise environment.
* Previous collaboration with global teams, offshore teams, and external vendors.

title: Center Director Sarjapur and Sahakarnagar Location
description:
**About us** 




 At Openhouse, we are building a network of premium play based learning centres across Bangalore. Our learning centres offer preschool, childcare and co\-curricular activities for ages 1\-10 years. We believe that modern parents are seeking professionally run schools that are child\-centric, have quality infrastructure and follow global pedagogies.
 



 Our learning centres are different from traditional K\-12 schools or preschools. We are building learning hubs (micro\-schools) at a neighbourhood level where parents can send children for play school, nursery, kindergarten and a range of co\-curricular activities from dance to drama, chess to robotics!
 



  





**The problem** 




 We realise that in big urban metros, parents preferences are changing:
 


1. Families are more nuclear and there are a lot of childcare responsibilities especially in the early years which they need to figure out on their own.
2. Parents are dissatisfied with existing preschools due to an overemphasis on academics with subpar educators and infrastructure.



  





 Looking at the above, Openhouse is trying to bridge the gap for modern thoughtful parents and be their support partner in the first 10 years of parenting. We have been on this mission since 2018 and already have 12 live learning centres across Bangalore and Kolkata where we help 4000\+ families and mentor 200\+ educators.
 



  






 Click here to take a look at our modern centres.
 





 Click here to view our Instagram Page
 




  





**Who are we?** 




  





 Founded by Stanford alumni and headquartered in Bangalore, Openhouse is an Ed Tech Startup. We emphasise on play based learning and believe that the future of education lies in designing games and activities that promote peer based learning. This philosophy reflects in each team member at Openhouse. Our team’s background spans institutions like Harvard, MIT, IIT, and ISB, and companies like Cult.fit and Truecaller. We’re backed by leading global education investors who believe in us.
 



  





**What is the role?** 




 As a Centre Director at Openhouse, you will play a pivotal role in managing one learning centre entrusted to you. It’s a role that allows you to build that centre in your neighborhood and create social and economical impact.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Working with our enthusiastic teachers by building an inclusive, growth oriented culture.
* Implementing our Curriculum in the centre for both preschool and afterschool programs
* Managing day to day functioning of the centre
* Owning the Professional Development of the entire team by bridging any knowledge or skill gaps.
* Maintaining open and effective communication with parents, sharing insights into their child's progress and milestones.



  





**Who is the ideal candidate?** 




 We are looking for someone who\-
 


* Has at least 4\-5 years of being a Preschool Teacher in a Premium Early Childhood Education school.
* Has good team management experience and has led teams before
* Has good communication and team building skills
* Is willing to be entrepreneurial and do whatever it takes to grow a learning centre in their community.
* Is outgoing and able to hold good quality conversations with parents, teachers and students alike
* Loves being around children and is passionate about quality education
* A course in Early Childhood Education or a B.Ed or NTT, MTT would also be great to have and is a bonus.



  





**Things you should know before applying** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Timings: 8:30am to 5pm
* 5 day working week (However, 1 day of the weekend will be working, non negotiable)

 Metrics
   

  

* Works with vendors to jointly design, develop, install and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to effectively measure, manage, and visually show the impact and value of the vendor’s products and services to CRE

* At the request of the Sourcing/Procurement function, the vendor manager will participate in and contribute to pre\-award negotiations, dispute resolution negotiations and contract amendment negotiations


 Sustainable Procurement
   

  

* Engage suppliers representing 66% of Equinix supplier base to set their own carbon emission reduction targets by year\-end, 2026 and to reduce absolute emissions from fuel and gas activities by 50% by 2030 from a 2019 baseline year

title: Manager/Sr Manager- Fraud Operations
description:
**Our journey so far** 




 Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer\-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea: to create a modern, customer\-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.
 



  





 From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter \- and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2\.8 million\+ happy users on Jupiter.
 



  





 Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head\-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No\-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/\- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.
 



 We've embraced cutting\-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like\-minded folks to join the crew.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Manager/Senior Manager – Fraud Operations (Customer Support)** 
 to lead a team of
 **Fraud Analysts** 
 responsible for managing fraud\-related customer interactions across inbound calls, emails, and chats. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in fraud investigations, customer support operations, stakeholder management, team leadership, and process improvement within the banking or fintech ecosystem. This role requires a balance of operational excellence, people management, customer\-centricity, and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage a team of 9–10 fraud analysts, ensuring timely, accurate, and high\-quality resolution of fraud\-related customer queries across calls, emails, and chat channels.
* Investigate suspicious transactions, account freezes, financial crime alerts, and potential fraud cases using internal fraud monitoring tools and risk indicators.
* Review and recommend decisions related to account restrictions, account unfreezing, lien removal, and account closures in accordance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and guidelines from partner banks.
* Coordinate with partner banks, vendors (e.g., Freshdesk, Jira, Ozonetel), internal stakeholders, Compliance, Risk, Product, Operations, Customer support and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) to facilitate fraud investigations and regulatory requests.
* Handle high\-priority customer escalations while ensuring professional, empathetic, and policy\-compliant communication.
* Monitor and drive operational performance against key metrics, including SLA adherence, productivity, quality, CSAT, First Response Time (FRT), Average Handling Time (AHT), and Turnaround Time (TAT).
* Conduct quality audits, provide coaching and regular performance feedback, and mentor team members to improve productivity, quality, and customer experience.
* Develop, review, and continuously enhance fraud investigation processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), knowledge articles, and customer support workflows.
* Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and management presentations on fraud trends, operational performance, productivity, and key business metrics.
* Drive automation initiatives and continuous process improvements to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance investigation accuracy.
* Manage critical fraud incidents and ensure timely communication, escalation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support workforce planning, capacity management, scheduling, and resource allocation to meet business requirements and service levels.
* Analyse fraud trends and identify opportunities to strengthen fraud prevention controls by collaborating with Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Data Analytics teams.
* Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines, AML/KYC regulations, NPCI guidelines, internal policies, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks.



**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. A postgraduate qualification (MBA or equivalent) is preferred.
* **5–6 years** 
 of experience in Fraud Operations, AML, Customer Support, Risk Operations, Financial Crime, or Fraud Investigations within the Banking or Fintech industry.
* Minimum
 **3–4 years** 
 of experience leading teams in a Team Lead or Assistant Manager capacity.
* Proven experience managing customer support operations and fraud Prevention teams in a high\-volume environment.
* Strong understanding of fraud operations, transaction monitoring, customer profiling, fraud investigation \& prevention , Mule accounts, account lifecycle management, and customer risk assessment.
* Experience handling Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) requests, partner bank coordination, regulatory compliance, and fraud escalations.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM and ticketing platforms such as Freshdesk, Jira, Salesforce, Ozonetel, or similar systems.
* Excellent analytical and decision\-making skills with the ability to investigate complex fraud scenarios and make risk\-based decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, dashboards, reporting), Microsoft PowerPoint, and operational MIS reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, coaching, and people management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume operational environment while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and conflict\-resolution abilities.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in Digital Banking, UPI, IMPS, NEFT/RTGS, card fraud, payment fraud, account takeover (ATO), mule account investigations, and cyber fraud operations.
* Exposure to fraud detection systems, workflow automation, operational excellence initiatives, and AI\-driven fraud monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of RBI regulations, AML/KYC requirements, NPCI guidelines, customer dispute management, and financial crime compliance.
* Experience driving process improvement initiatives and implementing operational best practices.

 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. This is a predominantly operations\-focused leadership role (70% Operations / 30% Strategic), with a strong mandate to ensure operational excellence while driving sustainable and profitable business growth. The role will manage an established team and work closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver seamless customer service, strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to expand the business.

* 10\+ years of relevant experience in Road Transportation / Contract Logistics.

* Prior experience managing teams and leading people.
* Strong understanding of P\&L management, commercial performance and business growth.
* Ability to balance operational execution with a broader strategic and commercial perspective.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience managing vendors, transportation partners and service delivery.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence while maintaining customer satisfaction and profitability.


**What's in it for you**
 At Kuehne\+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
   

  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.

**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Incident Manager
description:
**Why should you choose us?** 




 Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security.
 



 Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com.
 



  





 Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.
 



  





 To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud\-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.
 



  





 Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!
 



  





 About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755\) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e\-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.
 



  





**About Department:** 




 The Network Operations (SXC) Division at Rakuten Mobile is pioneering the future of telecommunications through a fully virtualized, cloud\-native architecture. We are transitioning from traditional manual operations to an Autonomous Network Operations model. We are looking for an AI\-Ops Manager to lead this transformation, running our incident management function through the deployment, supervision, and continuous refinement of Agentic AI models.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 You will not just manage incidents; you will manage the AI agents that resolve them. Your mission is to minimize MTTR (Mean Time To Recovery) by overseeing an AI\-first operational environment, ensuring our cloud\-native network (Open RAN/Core) remains resilient through autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI intervention.
 



**Job Duties:** 



* **Agentic AI Supervision \& Incident Command:** 
 Serve as the lead incident commander, monitoring and steering Agentic AI models as they perform real\-time diagnostics and remediation. You are responsible for the "Human\-in\-the\-loop" (HITL) oversight of these agents, ensuring they operate within safety guardrails.
* **AI\-Orchestrated Operations:** 
 Manage the end\-to\-end incident lifecycle by orchestrating AI\-driven workflows across CLOUD/CORE/IPTX/RAN/OSS/BSS. You will validate AI\-generated root cause analysis (RCA) and approve autonomous remediation actions.
* **AI Knowledge Hub Management:** 
 Own the evolution of our AI\-based Knowledge Hub. You will ensure that AI models continuously ingest network telemetry and incident data to generate, update, and refine autonomous resolution articles, turning past incidents into future AI\-driven preventative logic.
* **Predictive Network Resilience:** 
 Leverage AI capabilities to shift from reactive to predictive operations. Use AI\-driven observability to detect anomalies before they impact the end customer, proactively triggering agentic workflows to mitigate service degradation.
* **Model Performance Tuning:** 
 Act as the primary owner of the AIOps roadmap. Regularly audit the decision\-making logic of AI agents, refine their training data, and optimize their performance to ensure maximum accuracy in complex, cloud\-native network environments.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Present AI\-derived incident insights to senior management, utilizing data\-backed trends to drive infrastructure improvements and architectural changes.



  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 



* **Work Experience:** 
 Minimum 7 years in Telecom/IT operations, with at least 2 years specifically focused on AIOps, machine learning operations (MLOps), or AI\-driven network automation.



**Core Technical Skills:** 



* **Agentic AI Mastery:** 
 Deep expertise in managing autonomous agents. Ability to interpret agent decision\-making paths, troubleshoot automation failures, and perform real\-time steering during critical outages.
* **Cloud\-Native \& Telecom Expertise:** 
 Expert\-level knowledge of Open RAN, Kubernetes, containerized network functions (CNFs), and cloud\-native architecture.
* **AIOps Tooling:** 
 Proficiency in operating enterprise\-grade monitoring systems and ticketing systems that integrate with AI\-driven observability platforms.
* **Knowledge Management:** 
 Experience managing AI\-based knowledge ecosystems where documentation is dynamically generated and maintained by machine learning models.
* **Process Mastery:** 
 Strong alignment with ITIL frameworks, adapted for a high\-velocity, automated, AI\-first environment
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Exceptional ability to synthesize high\-dimensional technical data into actionable strategic intelligence



  





**Preferred Qualification:** 



* Advanced degree or certification in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Machine Learning.
* Experience in Python or other scripting languages for the purpose of creating custom AI\-agent integrations or automation hooks.
* Proven track record of leading a successful digital transformation from manual operations to an AI\-automated or "Self\-Healing" network model.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud (e.g., CKA/CKAD) and ITIL 4 (Managing Professional).



  





**RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:** 




 Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.
 


* **Always improve, always advance.** 
 Only be satisfied with complete success \- Kaizen.
* **Be passionately professional.** 
 Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
* **Hypothesize \- Practice \- Validate \- Shikumika.** 
 Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
* **Maximize Customer Satisfaction.** 
 The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
* **Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!** 
 Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

* 5–8 years in customer service/complaints/escalations, ideally in BFSI, travel, or BPO/back\-office operations
* Direct experience handling regulatory or ombudsman\-referred complaints

* Advanced Excel proficiency (dashboards, trackers, pivot tables, reporting)
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, especially on regulatory or time\-bound cases
* Strong written communication — able to draft RCA documents and formal bank/regulator correspondence independently
* Working knowledge of refund/chargeback/reconciliation processes, ideally travel or payments domain
* Comfortable making judgment calls on compensation within financial authority limits


**Good to Have**
* Experience working with OTA partners (MakeMyTrip, Cleartrip, Goibibo, etc.) or airline refund processes
* Exposure to RBI/banking ombudsman process specifically
* Excel proficiency for SLA/aging dashboards


**Key Metrics (Success Measures)**
* TAT adherence on escalated cases
* Regulatory case closure quality (no repeat escalations to Ombudsman)
* Compensation spend vs. budget/credit pool
* Customer satisfaction / repeat complaint rate

title: R&D IAC Operations and Communication Manager
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** 
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Role Title:** 
 R\&D IAC Operations and Communication Manager
   

  

**Level:** 
 P2
   

  

**Location:** 
 IAC, Bangalore
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 R\&D Site Lead
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role is a strategic partner and force multiplier to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team, operating at the center of site leadership rather than in support of it. This role is responsible for translating global \& site strategy into tangible action, culture \& communication at Elanco Innovation \& Alliance Center (IAC). This role is responsible for serving as the chief of operations and communications for the local site. The person in this role serves as a trusted extension of the R\&D Lead Team, representing the office in forums where sound judgment, discretion, and credibility are essential. The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R\&D Lead Team.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership \& Site Leadership**
* Serve as strategic advisor and thought partner to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team shaping how strategic initiatives translate into concrete site\-level action
* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and support business case development for strategic site capabilities, including opportunities to enhance IAC’s role as an AI hub within the R\&D, partnering on the AI COP
* Build and sustain direct working partnerships with R\&D executive and functional lead team members, acting as a trusted point of contact on their behalf for site\-level priorities, cross\-functional dependencies, and follow\-through


**Executive Communications \& Organizational Narrative**
* Provide support and enable successful delivery of flagship site events such as R\&D Connect Week —from theme and content architecture through post\-event communications to the larger audiences (internal \& external)
* Facilitate and support senior leadership engagement initiatives including townhalls, and speaker preparation
* Provide communications support for the Site Lead by helping craft executive briefings, leader emails, and broader site communications that are impactful, engaging, and people\-centric
* Build and protect a consistent communications narrative that ties site activity back to a central R\&D theme across the year


**Organizational Health**
* Work closely with the HSE Lead and team, providing coordination and operational support while acting as an integral member of the team.
* Champion site culture enhancement ideas that include employee engagement initiatives, cross\-functional team building activities, and serving as the R\&D ERG Liaison in partnership with the EBS ERG Leadership.
* Lead organizational change management (OCM) on site, through major transitions, pairing structured process with communication that helps people make sense of what's changing and why
* Partner with R\&D Lead Team to collate talent advancement and the STA (short\-term assignment) pipeline for talent across the site


**Governance, Project \& Team Leadership**
* Project manage operational initiatives to delivery representing the local R\&D Lead Team and global functional leaders
* Schedule and facilitate R\&D Lead Team meetings, floor initiatives and cross\-functional governance forums, capture minutes, key decisions \+ action points
* Own the site's project portfolio dashboard and reporting cadence for leadership and global stakeholders
* Maintain oversight of site operations (logistics, visitor and delegate management, calendar and travel support for visiting leaders), ensuring consistent quality and timeliness
* Potentially own and execute site based projects


**Additional Preferences**
* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to leaders in a global, matrixed organization
* Executive presence and the discretion to handle highly confidential, sensitive matters
* Exceptional written communication — able to write convincingly and authentically
* Track record of driving execution across functions without formal authority
* Comfort leading through ambiguity and building structure or governance where none previously existed


**Other Information**
* Based in Bangalore, India, at the IAC site, expected to complete 30 days/Quarter of in\-office presence.
* Frequent partnership with global, cross\-time\-zone stakeholders across the US and Europe
* Proficiency across the MS Office suite; comfortable adopting AI and new\-age content tools


 Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. title: EYP-Working Capital-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Parthenon – S\&E \- WCAS (Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
 WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom\-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
   

  

 Our team is committed to improving the cash\-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in\-depth analysis and benchmarking, data\-driven diagnostics of Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, and Forecast\-to\-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers with 9\-12 years of work experience and expertise across Order to cash (OTC), Procure to pay (PTP) and inventory optimization and have clear inroads to deliver on Working Capital Management Analytics. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a growing firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning \& development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead engagement teams executing WCAS which support key conclusions in developing and executing their Cash strategy and process optimization programs
* Assess the client's state of readiness with respect to people, resources, planning, data collection and strategy, while identifying high\-risk areas, unidentified issues and areas for overall improvement.
* Build relationships with EY offices across the globe, and demonstrate knowledge of regional practices. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement process and work products
* Demonstrate strong knowledge in a particular industry (e.g., manufacturing, life sciences, consumer product goods, industrial products, technology, retail, PE etc.).
* Assist in business development activities including preparing presentations for pursuit meetings with clients to help sell advisory services
* Develop expertise on AP, AR and inventory optimization and comprehensive working capital analytics
* Qualitative research and presentations to support client strategy and EY business development activities using AI assistants such as Copilot etc.
* Develop best practices, supervise, coach, and mentor team members at the junior level.
* Manage and expand the existing set of stakeholders and build strong engagement metrics
* Displays the following qualities
+ Manages own time to budgets and communicates progress against Project Plans
+ flexibility with changing tasks
+ high quality awareness
+ strong and open personality by pointing out issues and drives improvement ideas


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just\-in\-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote\-to\-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure\-to\-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Process Transformation experience\- candidates with hands on experience of operational turnaround services \- process design and improvement, planning, sourcing etc.
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Ability to determine risks and opportunity areas, assess findings and communicate insights
* Proven experience in interacting with senior management of clients
* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation skills
* Excellent people management and interpersonal skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience in developing final presentations
* Experience managing staff on multiple projects and providing direction to team members
* Experience in selling and delivering projects that cover the full lifecycle of assessment, design and implementation support.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 9\-12 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects (min. 4\-6 years) related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost reduction, increased cash flow, etc.).


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills


**What You Can Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

 EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
