title: AD - Program Management ( Central Operations)
description:
**Role:** 
 AD \- Program Management ( Central Operations)
 



**Location** 
 : Bengaluru
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Business Head 
 



**Experience:** 
 7–9 years in operations, program management, consulting, or logistics, with team leadership experience
 








**About Loadshare:** 




 LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan\-India, multi\-category last\-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns. What sets us apart:
 



 ●      Scale with depth: We handle \~550K deliveries/day across food, e\-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 40,000\+ rider network.
 



 ●      Strong financials, stronger ambition: With ₹800 Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
 



 ●      Dual\-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last\-mile delivery network, but also license our in\-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross\-utilization across verticals.
 



 ●      Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility), and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co\-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
 



 ●      Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital\-efficient, tech\-enabled logistics engine in the country.
 



 We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale\-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.
 



 Founders/ Founding team:
 



 ●      Raghu Talluri (CEO) \- Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
 



 ●      Pramod Nair (CTO) \- Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
 



 ●      Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)\- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco
 



 ●      Overall 500\+ employees on roll
 








**Role Overview** 




 Loadshare Networks is a leading 3PL partner for one of our largest quick\-commerce clients, playing a critical role in building and scaling their quick commerce and last\-mile delivery ecosystem across India. With SaaS\-led capabilities and on\-ground operations spanning 150\+ stores pan\-India, Loadshare operates at the intersection of technology, operations, and scale.
 



 As Associate Director – Program Management (Central Operations), you will own the rate card setup and payouts process end to end — the systems, controls and processes that determine how Delivery Executives (DEs) are paid. Rate card structures are configured, validated and deployed across a large multi\-city store network, and the resulting earnings are computed, verified and released on a weekly cycle. Accuracy, turnaround and reliability/system robustness are the measures of success in this role.
 



 The work is equal parts process design, client management and working with product. A team handles day\-to\-day execution and query resolution; your mandate is to make the process scalable and to solve issues at the root.
 



 You will partner closely with Operations, Product, Tech, Finance and client stakeholders, and lead a team of analysts and associates alongside a dedicated product manager to translate strategy into execution and measurable outcomes.

title: Sourcing Leader – Supplier Performance Management
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
   

  

 At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

 The SL SPM is responsible to perform SPM tasks related to his/her/their assigned Cytiva operating companies, business units and sites with focus on continuously improving the performance of key suppliers in\-line with Cytiva’s and its customers’ requirements. The individual is the subject matter expert for supplier performance improvement projects through the application of data\-driven methods with emphasis on Lean, DBS @ Supplier and select Cytiva sourcing tools. The SL SPM holds the responsibility of identifying supplier candidates for performance improvement projects jointly with the sourcing leaders at the assigned sites, BU(s) or operating companies. Once identified, the SL SPM prepares, facilitates and drives supplier projects to conclusion which includes the coordination of cross\-functional Cytiva resources required to enable the supplier to reach and sustain the targeted performance level (eg. SQE, SCM, Materials, Sourcing, Engineering).
   

  

 The role is global and covers all relevant parts, materials, services and suppliers associated to the specific portfolio assigned to the SL SPM. A high level of regular and ad\-hoc on\-site and remote / virtual interaction with sourcing or category leaders, supply chain, materials management, supplier quality assurance, R\&D, new product introduction and other functions is required.
   

  

 Plans, prepares, facilitates and completes supplier performance improvement projects based on requests and inputs from BU Sourcing leadership (incl. projects on supplier premises).
   

  

* Applies select Lean, DBS and sourcing tools / methods to improve supplier performance with impact on capacity, OTD, lead\-times, TCO, inventory and other relevant factors.
* Provides tools, improvement methods and supplier\-related insights into sourcing strategy development and execution at the assigned sites.
* Supports sourcing or category leaders in the preparation of supplier negotiations.
* Coaches Cytiva and supplier resources in the application and sustainment of select Lean, DBS and sourcing tools as beneficial to improve supplier performance.
* Provides critical input during the planning and priorization process for supplier improvement projects.
* Communicates the results of supplier improvement projects to Cytiva stakeholders and archives project documentation.
* Implements best practices and develops SL SPM tools, methods, KPIs and strategies in\-line with Cytiva’s priorities.
* Performs other tasks as assigned.


**Qualifications And Requirements, Education And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Procurement/Sourcing/Supply Management, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline.
* Advanced to expert knowledge in select DBS tools (e.g. PSP, VSM, Kaizen, SW, DBS@Supplier, DMS) which are relevant to improve supplier performance. Certification in one or multiple DBS tools a plus.
* Advanced project management skills.
* Advanced supplier assessment / auditing skills.
* Ability to perform in a virtual team environment, at remote locations (including supplier sites) and on global level.
* 5\+ years working experience in complex supply chains and with international suppliers, ideally including problem\-solving and continuous improvement projects targeting supplier capacity, OTD, lead\-time, TCO and inventory improvements.
* Advanced knowledge in Lean or other supplier performance management tools and practices.
* Experience in working in a matrix organization and proven track record of achieving results as a member or leader of multi\-functional teams.
* Ability to travel globally.
* Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
* Fluent in oral and written English.


 Behavioral characteristics
   

  

* Strong ability to inspire and engage, create context and take the lead including the successful preparation, facilitation and conclusion of meetings and workshops on international level.
* Considers different points of views, consolidates data and facts and based on these prioritizes and makes decisions.
* Presents and communicates with impact, simplifies complex information and data and communicates the information clearly across all levels of the company.


 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Checkout Services Team Leader

 We are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused leader who is passionate about creating a great shopping experience and developing people. You enjoy working in a fast\-paced retail environment and are confident in making decisions, prioritising tasks and supporting your team.
   

  

 You bring:
   

 •Experience in checkout services, retail or a customer\-focused service environment.
   

 •Strong ability to organise and prioritise your own work and the work of others.
   

 •Ability to plan staffing according to customer flow and business needs.
   

 •A customer\-first mindset with the ability to understand and respond to customer needs.
   

 •Good communication skills and the ability to adapt your communication style to different people.
   

 •Confidence in making decisions and solving customer or operational issues.
   

 •Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

 •Computer proficiency and the ability to read and understand written English.
   

 •A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different functions.

 As a Checkout Services Team Leader, you will be responsible for ensuring a fast, efficient, accurate and friendly checkout experience for our customers while supporting the business and your team.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

 •Lead and support checkout co\-workers to deliver a positive payment experience for every customer.
   

 •Ensure the checkout area is well maintained, properly equipped and ready throughout the day.
   

 •Make sure the right number of co\-workers are in the right place at the right time, based on customer flow.
   

 •Monitor queues and waiting times and take appropriate action to maintain agreed service levels.

 Conduct daily spot checks to ensure proper payment and operational accuracy.
   

 •Coach and develop checkout co\-workers, building their knowledge, confidence and ability to support customers.

 •Work with the manager and other functions to identify root causes of recurring problems and implement better ways of working.

 •Monitor daily and weekly service performance and take action when results are below expectations.
   

 •Support cost\-effective ways of working while balancing business needs with customer satisfaction.
   

 •Act as a role model for IKEA values and contribute to a positive and collaborative team culture.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 Where others see home furnishing products, we see smart solutions to create a better everyday life. With a great deal of passion, imagination and brainstorming we turn colours, textiles and furniture into inspiring environments that excite, engage and convince IKEA visitors that they can do it too
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Lead MSAT OSD
description:
**Department:** 
 Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT)
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Experience:** 
 12–18 years
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




  





 Lead MSAT activities for Oral Solid Dosage products, including technology transfer, scale\-up, process validation, commercialization, troubleshooting, continuous process verification, and lifecycle management for regulated markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 \* Lead technology transfer of OSD products from R\&D, other manufacturing sites, or external partners to commercial manufacturing.
 



 \* Manage scale\-up, exhibit, registration, process performance qualification (PPQ), and commercial validation batches.
 



 \* Conduct manufacturing process assessments covering dispensing, blending, wet and dry granulation, fluid\-bed processing, compression, coating, capsule filling, and packing.
 



 \* Establish critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, material attributes, process controls, and proven acceptable ranges.
 



 \* Prepare and review technology\-transfer documents, risk assessments, process validation protocols/reports, batch manufacturing records, SOPs, and technical reports.
 



 \* Perform equipment and facility\-fit assessments and identify requirements for new equipment, modifications, or capacity enhancement.
 



 \* Lead troubleshooting of manufacturing deviations, OOS/OOT results, yield losses, process variability, product complaints, and recurring failures.
 



 \* Apply structured root\-cause analysis and statistical tools such as DOE, trend analysis, FMEA, Minitab, or JMP.
 



 \* Develop and implement CAPAs and verify their effectiveness.
 



 \* Lead continuous process verification and periodic product/process performance reviews.
 



 \* Drive improvements in yield, cycle time, batch size, capacity utilization, right\-first\-time performance, productivity, and cost of goods.
 



 \* Support new product launches, alternate\-source qualifications, process changes, raw\-material changes, and site\-transfer projects.
 



 \* Work closely with Formulation R\&D, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Supply Chain, and EHS.
 



 \* Provide technical support during regulatory submissions, customer audits, and inspections by USFDA, EMA, MHRA, and other regulatory agencies.
 



 \* Mentor MSAT team members and strengthen technical problem\-solving capabilities across manufacturing operations.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





 \* B.Pharm or M.Pharm, preferably with specialization in Pharmaceutics or Pharmaceutical Technology.
 



 \* 12–18 years of pharmaceutical experience, with significant exposure to OSD manufacturing, MSAT, technology transfer, scale\-up, or process validation.
 



 \* Strong experience with tablets and capsules, including immediate\-release and modified\-release products.
 



 \* Demonstrated experience in transferring and commercializing products for regulated markets.
 



 \* Sound knowledge of cGMP, data integrity, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10, Quality by Design, process validation, change control, deviation investigation, and CAPA systems.
 



 \* Strong understanding of formulation–process–equipment interactions and scale\-up principles.
 



 \* Experience handling multiple projects and working with cross\-functional and multi\-site teams.
 



 \* Good leadership, stakeholder\-management, documentation, presentation, and communication skills.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





 \* Successful execution of multiple product transfers, PPQ campaigns, and commercial launches.
 



 \* Exposure to high\-potent products, containment systems, or complex/modified\-release formulations.
 



 \* Knowledge of statistical process control, Lean Six Sigma, Minitab, or JMP.

 Summary: We are seeking a dedicated and detail\-oriented Service Delivery Manager to join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team, supporting a major US\-based client. The role focuses on operational activities with additional responsibilities around team management and client management. This is a hands\-on operational role requiring support in a 24x7 environment, following a rotational shift model. Roles \& Responsibilities: 1\. Service Management \& SLA Compliance \-This is the core of the role, focused on ensuring the applications are running smoothly and meeting the agreed\-upon service levels. \-SLA Management: Define, document, negotiate, and agree upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the client for each application. \-Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor application performance, availability, and reliability against the defined SLA metrics (e.g., uptime, response time, resolution time). \-Incident Management: Oversee the entire lifecycle of incidents (service disruptions, bugs). This includes ensuring prompt logging, accurate prioritization, and effective communication to stakeholders. \-Major Incident Leadership: Act as the primary point of command and coordination during high\-priority (P1/P2\) incidents, ensuring rapid response, mobilizing resolution teams, and managing stakeholder communication. \-Problem Management: Go beyond just fixing incidents by driving root cause analysis (RCA) to identify and eliminate recurring issues and prevent future disruptions. \-Change Management: Review and approve changes to the application environments, assessing risk and ensuring that deployments do not negatively impact service stability. \-Service Request Fulfillment: Ensure that standard service requests from users (e.g., access requests, minor configurations) are fulfilled efficiently and within agreed timelines. \-Documentation: Maintain SOPs, documentation, and runbooks for supported applications. Review the documentation periodically for changes and get it reviewed from client SME. 2\. Client Management \& Communication \-This area focuses on maintaining a strong, transparent, and positive relationship with the business client. \-Primary Point of Contact: Act as the main liaison between the client's business stakeholders and the technical support team. \-Client Escalation Handling: Serve as the first point of escalation for the client for any service\-related issues, concerns, or complaints, taking ownership until resolution. \-Service Review Meetings: Prepare for and conduct regular service review meetings (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with client stakeholders. \-Reporting: Develop and present comprehensive reports on service performance, including SLA achievement, incident trends, ongoing problems, and continuous improvement initiatives. \-Building Relationships: Proactively build and maintain strong relationships with key business users and client leadership to foster trust and partnership. \-Understanding Business Needs: Develop a deep understanding of the client's business processes and how the supported applications enable their objectives to provide context\-aware support. 3\. Team Management \& Leadership \-This involves managing the day\-to\-day operations and long\-term development of the technical support team. \-Roster Preparation \& Shift Management: Create and manage team rosters and shift schedules to ensure 24/7 or business\-hour coverage as required by the SLAs. \-Leave Planning: Manage and approve team leave requests, ensuring adequate staffing levels are maintained at all times to avoid service degradation. \-Technical Work Assignment: \-Triage incoming tickets and assign them to team members based on their skills, current workload, and ticket priority. \-Ensure a balanced distribution of work across the team. \-Monitor ticket queues and reassign work as necessary to avoid SLA breaches. \-Performance Management: Set clear goals and objectives for team members, conduct regular performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback. \-Skill Development \& Training: Identify skill gaps within the team and arrange for necessary training and development opportunities to enhance technical and service capabilities. \-Mentoring \& Coaching: Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to team members to foster their career growth and maintain high morale. \-Resource Planning: Forecast future resource needs based on application complexity, ticket volumes, and upcoming projects. 4\. Continuous Improvement \& Strategy \-Process Improvement: Continuously analyze existing support processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement (e.g., implementing ITIL best practices). \-Trend Analysis: Analyze incident and service request data to identify recurring themes, patterns, and areas for service improvement. \-Automation Initiatives: Identify repetitive manual tasks and advocate for or lead automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce human error. \-Knowledge Management: Champion the creation and maintenance of a robust knowledge base with standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and FAQs for both the support team and end\-users. \-Vendor Management: If third\-party vendors are involved in the application support, manage these relationships to ensure they meet their contractual obligations. \-Budget \& Cost Management: Contribute to the management of the support budget, looking for ways to deliver services more cost\-effectively without sacrificing quality. Professional \& Technical Skills: \-Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Active Directory, data encryption, PKI, ADFS, Okta, Enterprise applications. \-Experience in certificate lifecycle management for diverse enterprise environments. \-Familiarity with Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS). \-Knowledge on DigiCert certificates and management. \-Good understanding of SSL/TLS protocols and digital certificates troubleshooting. \-Basic scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation of routine tasks. \-Ability to work in 24x7 rotational shifts and support global clients. \-Strong communication and documentation skills. Additional Information: \- The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Identity Access Management (IAM). \- This position is based at our Bengaluru office. \- A 15 years full time education is required. \- Microsoft certifications related to security or infrastructure. \- Azure Security, AZ\-305, SC\-300 or SC\-900 (optional, for IAM).

title: GTM Operations Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on Marketing Operations Manager to own the demand generation engine end\-to\-end \- the systems, workflows, campaign execution, and the reporting that tells us what's working. This is an execution\-first role: you will run the marketing automation stack (HubSpot) day\-to\-day, ship campaigns and workflows yourself, and turn funnel data into specific, actionable recommendations. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, and Inside Sales \- acting as both the builder who gets things live and the advisor who helps these teams do their jobs better through process and data. A strong AI\-first mindset is essential: you should already be using AI/agentic tools to automate operational work and speed up analysis, not just as a stated interest.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 









**Marketing Automation \& MarTech Ownership (HubSpot)** 




 Own HubSpot end\-to\-end: platform administration, licensing/procurement input, integrations (CRM, forms, ad platforms, enrichment tools), and ongoing configuration.
 



 Build and maintain workflows, lead scoring, list segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead routing rules.
 



 Maintain data quality and hygiene across the database (deduplication, enrichment, field standardization, sync integrity with CRM).
 



 Evaluate, procure, and manage adjacent MarTech tools as the stack evolves.
 








**Demand Gen Process \& Campaign Execution** 




 Manage and continuously improve the demand generation process \- from lead capture through MQL/SQL handoff.
 



 Execute multi\-channel campaigns (email, paid, webinar, ABM) in HubSpot, including build, QA, and launch.
 



 Identify friction points in the funnel and drive process fixes in partnership with Field Marketing and Inside Sales.
 








**Analytics \& Reporting** 




 Build and maintain reporting on campaign performance, the demand gen funnel, and channel effectiveness (dashboards, not one\-off decks).
 



 Go beyond reporting: proactively flag where performance is lagging and recommend specific tweaks to accelerate pipeline velocity and outreach effectiveness.
 



 Own attribution reporting and connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
 








**AI\-First Automation** 




 Apply AI/agentic workflows to automate operational tasks (list building, reporting, QA, campaign ops) and to accelerate analysis (anomaly detection, funnel diagnostics, natural\-language reporting).
 



 Continuously look for opportunities to replace manual, repetitive marketing ops work with automated or agent\-driven processes.
 








**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 




 Act as the go\-to executor for PMM, Field Marketing, and Inside Sales on anything requiring HubSpot or campaign operations support.
 



 Advise these teams on marketing operations best practices \- segmentation, nurture design, lead handoff, reporting hygiene \- without owning their strategy.
 








**What We're Looking For** 




 3\-6 years in marketing operations, demand generation operations, or a similar hands\-on execution role.
 



 Deep, current hands\-on HubSpot expertise (admin\-level) \- workflows, lead scoring, reporting, integrations. Certification is a plus.
 



 Strong analytical skills: comfortable in spreadsheets/SQL/BI tools, and able to translate funnel data into a recommendation, not just a chart.
 



 Demonstrated experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to automate marketing operations or analytics work (not just general AI familiarity).
 



 A bias toward shipping \- comfortable owning execution end\-to\-end rather than only planning or strategizing.
 



 Experience working cross\-functionally with sales/inside sales teams and understanding of the demand gen funnel (MQL/SQL/SAL definitions, lead routing, handoff SLAs).
 



 Clear, confident communicator who can advise peer teams on best practice without formal authority over them.
 








**Nice to Have** 




 Experience evaluating or procuring MarTech tools (vendor selection, contracting, rollout).
 



 Exposure to CRM platforms (Salesforce or similar) and lead\-to\-revenue reporting.
 



 Experience in B2B SaaS / enterprise software demand generation.
 








**Success Metrics** 




 Achieve and maintain a minimum 20% MQL\-to\-SQL conversion rate.
 



 Campaign turnaround time of 5 days or less (request to live).
 



 Weekly/bi\-weekly reporting on the marketing funnel and channel performance, with actionable insights.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Production Manager is responsible for leading end\-to\-end manufacturing operations for system integration, assembly, packing, and dispatch of telecom products. The role ensures seamless conversion of PCBA cards received from Contract Manufacturers and mechanical chassis received from vendors into finished products through controlled manufacturing processes. The Production Manager is accountable for meeting production plans, ensuring zero\-defect execution, maintaining MES and SAP compliance, achieving operational excellence, and driving readiness for Prototype, Pilot, and Mass Production phases.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and deliver daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Lead system integration, product assembly, inspection, packing, and handover to Finished Goods (FG).
* Ensure manufacturing activities are executed as per approved SOPs, work instructions, and quality requirements.
* Drive productivity improvements while maintaining high quality and safety standards.
* Monitor production output, WIP, bottlenecks, and resource utilization.
* Ensure timely material availability for production through close coordination with Warehouse, SCM, and Planning teams.
* Manage production order execution in SAP PP.
* Ensure accurate BOM adherence and consumption during manufacturing.
* Monitor material movement, traceability, inventory accuracy, and shortage management.
* Ensure timely closure of production orders and reporting in SAP.
* Drive manufacturing traceability and process compliance.
* Ensure strict adherence to MES workflows across assembly, inspection, testing, packing, and dispatch processes.
* Ensure production records are maintained accurately and completely.
* Monitor MES transactions and resolve execution gaps.
* Ensure zero\-defect manufacturing through process adherence and robust quality controls.
* Work closely with QA teams to drive defect prevention, containment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with customer quality requirements and internal standards.
* Ensure compliance with customer quality requirements and internal standards.
* Lead root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, productivity, and cost.
* Lead assembly, integration, and packing teams to achieve production objectives.
* Manage manpower planning, shift operations, and skill development.
* Establish performance expectations and monitor team productivity.
* Drive employee engagement, discipline, safety culture, and continuous learning.
* Train and mentor engineers, technicians, and operators.
* Ensure readiness and maintenance of assembly lines, workstations, tools, fixtures, and packing infrastructure.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, ESD, and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational procedures.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Telecom Product Manufacturing and System Integration.
* Hands\-on experience in Assembly, Integration, and Production Operations.
* Good understanding of SAP PP, Production Orders, and BOM Management.
* Experience in MES\-driven manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of NPI, Prototype, Pilot, and Mass Production processes.
* Strong understanding of Quality Systems, CAPA, ESD, 5S, and Lean Manufacturing.
* Expertise in production planning, material flow management, and inventory control.
* Strong leadership, people management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and execution abilities.
* Ability to drive cross\-functional collaboration across Engineering, IE, QA, SCM, and Warehouse teams.


**Qualifications**
 Experience: 8\-12 years of experience in Electronics Manufacturing, Telecom Equipment Manufacturing, System Integration, Assembly Operations, and Production Management, including experience in NPI, Pilot, and Mass Production environments.
   

  

 Qualification: Diploma/BE / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
   

  

**About Us**
 Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R\&D. We design and manufacture high\-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading\-edge telecom products for building end\-to\-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99\.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O\-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS\-PON), carrier\-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct\-to\-Mobile and Satellite\-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R\&D\-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long\-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R\&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.
   

  

**Diversity And Inclusion Statement**
* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.


**About The Team**
 At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost\-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS\-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3\). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi\-terabit, chassis\-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Development involves specialized skills across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software, and synchronization, enabling teams to address multidisciplinary challenges effectively. Supporting these engineering efforts there is a centralized operational framework that provides strategic direction, governance, and essential services across the organization. This includes financial management, talent development, compliance, branding, innovation, risk management, and CSR. Together, these functions ensure seamless execution, alignment with business goals, and a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

title: Manager - RevOps & GTM Engineering
description:
**Born in India, Built for the World** 




  





 Amagi is an Emmy®\-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real\-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.
 



  





 Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:
 


* 9,000\+ channels across 300\+ content distributors
* 500,000\+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion\+ monetized ad impressions



  





 We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.
 



  





 Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.
 



  





 Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000\+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
 



 To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore
 
 here
 
 .
 



  





**Work Mode : Onsite** 




**Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  





**Marketing Operations Ownership** 



* Own the marketing\-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.
* Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands\-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.
* Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.



  





**AI\-Native Automation \& GTM Engineering** 



* Build end\-to\-end automations using a Claude \+ Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.
* Stand up advanced enrichment and account\-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).
* Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail\-safe, and maintainable.



  





**Reporting That Drives Outcomes** 



* Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.
* Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow\-through.
* Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30\-60\-90 reporting cadence.



  





**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 



* Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.
* Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy\-measure\-iterate experiments.



  





**Skills and Expertise Required:** 




  




* AI\-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.
* Hands\-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must\-have).
* Proven ability to build automations with Claude \+ Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.
* Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.
* Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.



  





**Competencies** 




  




* Funnel \& lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.
* Attribution \& measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and multi\-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.
* Campaign ops \& data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, compliance).
* Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.
* Planning \& stakeholder leadership: partner on target\-setting and multi\-BU campaign governance; drive cross\-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).
* B2B SaaS GTM experience (post\-IPO / high\-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.



  





**Who You Are** 



* AI\-first by default: you reach for a Claude\-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.
* Hands\-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.
* A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high\-growth environments.
* You flag data\-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished\-but\-wrong output.



  





**Life at Amagi:** 




 Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.
 


* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.** 
 Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.** 
 We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.** 
 We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.** 
 We dream big but execute with relentless precision.



  





**A Place That Takes Care of You:** 




 We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on\-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

 Onsite or Hybrid

 Standard India time

 Education:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field.


 Experience:
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience in digital marketing with at least 7\+ years in SEO, digital search, content optimization, or related digital marketing disciplines.

title: Supply Chain COE Capability Lead Role

title: Senior Associate, Accounts Payable
description:

 Revantage provides real estate services to Blackstone \- the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone’s real estate portfolio includes industrial \& logistics, residential, office, hospitality and retail properties in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Revantage’s global reach supports Blackstone real estate portfolio companies with best\-in\-class talent and corporate services \- from legal to technology, to people and culture. * Ensure team processes and procedures align with department guidelines and policies, recommending improvements where appropriate
* Partner with the US onshore AP team on staffing needs, process improvements, and reporting on team metrics

**Required Experience**

+ University/College Accounting degree consistent with local market expectations for role
+ Accounting certifications consistent with local market expectations for role


* Experience
+ 6 plus years of AP experience required

 Simpliwork is looking for an experienced
 **Project Controller** 
 to lead project planning, governance, documentation, commercial controls, and execution monitoring across multiple workplace fit\-out projects. The role will act as the central point of control for project schedules, budgets, documentation, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and performance reporting, ensuring successful delivery of projects within agreed timelines, cost, quality, and compliance standards.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience managing large\-scale commercial interior fit\-outs, corporate workplace projects, and multi\-location project portfolios with leading Project Management Consultants (PMC), real estate developers, or corporate real estate organizations.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 





 Project Planning \& Controls
 



* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules using equivalent planning tools (RDash).
* Prepare project execution plans, master schedules, critical path analysis, milestone trackers, and recovery plans.
* Monitor project progress against baseline schedules and proactively identify schedule risks and delays.
* Establish project governance frameworks, reporting standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms across multiple projects.



  






 Project Governance \& Documentation
 



* Develop and manage document control systems ensuring version control and timely approvals.
* Maintain project documentation including drawings, RFIs, submittals, change requests, design revisions, approval trackers, and project records.
* Ensure compliance with internal quality standards, client requirements, statutory regulations, and contractual obligations.
* Standardize project control processes across the organization.



  






 Commercial \& Financial Controls
 



* Track project budgets, cash flows, cost forecasts, commitments, and expenditure throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor procurement schedules, vendor commitments, payment milestones, and invoicing.
* Review BOQs, technical specifications, variation orders, and change management requests.
* Support value engineering initiatives and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.



  






 Design \& Technical Coordination
 



* Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, design teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure seamless project execution.
* Review design deliverables for constructability, technical compliance, and execution readiness.
* Facilitate timely design approvals and resolution of technical issues during execution.
* Support technical due diligence, statutory approvals, and design governance activities.



  






 Project Monitoring \& Reporting
 



* Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive MIS reports covering project progress, cost, schedule, risks, procurement status, and key performance indicators.
* Develop dashboards and project performance reports for senior leadership and clients.
* Present project health reviews and recommend corrective actions where required.



  






 Risk \& Change Management
 



* Maintain project risk registers and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Monitor project deviations, change orders, claims, and contractual obligations.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and drive timely resolution through cross\-functional collaboration.



  






 Stakeholder Management
 



* Serve as the primary coordination point between clients, consultants, contractors, internal departments, and leadership teams.
* Lead project review meetings, prepare meeting minutes, and ensure timely closure of action items.
* Foster effective communication across Design, Projects, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Leasing, and Operations functions.



  






 Procurement \& Vendor Coordination
 



* Coordinate RFQs, RFPs, vendor evaluations, technical bid reviews, and procurement planning.
* Track material approvals, procurement milestones, deliveries, and site readiness.
* Monitor vendor performance and contractual compliance throughout project execution.



  






 Quality, Compliance \& Handover
 



* Support quality audits, peer reviews, and project compliance checks.
* Ensure project deliverables meet client specifications, regulatory requirements, and Simpliwork quality standards.
* Coordinate final project documentation, snag closure, testing \& commissioning, and successful handover to Operations.



  





**Skillset required** 



* Experience in Project Controls, Project Planning, Design Management, or Project Management within commercial real estate or workplace interiors.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, cost control, documentation, procurement, and project governance.
* Experience working with leading PMCs, real estate developers, workplace consultants, or corporate occupiers.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in budgeting, cash flow management, contract administration, and value engineering.
* Knowledge of statutory approvals, technical due diligence, risk management, and change control processes.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.



  





**Experience (Years) required** 




 15\+ years of experience
 



  





**Qualification** 




 Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, or related discipline.

title: Implementation Lead
description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise accounts and the value they realise — leading a team of Engagement Managers and holding the outcome, not just the delivery. You’re the senior Aerchain owner for your portfolio: accountable for adoption, value realisation, retention and growth, the executive relationship, and the commercial health of every account. You set the delivery and governance standard your Engagement Managers run to, step in on the hardest escalations, and develop the team. You report to the Business Head.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Portfolio \& Value Ownership
 



  




* Own the outcomes across your portfolio — accountable for value realised, not just features shipped or projects closed.
* Hold the customer\-value metrics standard across all accounts; ensure every account can point to measurable value.
* Own the executive relationship with your portfolio’s most senior stakeholders.



  





 Team Leadership — Engagement Managers
 



  




* Lead and develop a team of Engagement Managers — build their judgment, and shape their output.
* Set the delivery, governance, and quality standard your Engagement Managers run to;
* review account health and keep them unblocked.
* Own allocation and coverage across the portfolio; step in personally on the hardest accounts and escalations.



  





 Customer Success
 



  




* Own retention, renewals, and expansion across the portfolio — protect and grow account value.
* Run executive business reviews; translate product value into customer outcomes and references.
* Own account health — renewal risk, expansion pipeline, and margin — partnering with Sales.



  





 Delivery Governance \& Escalation
 



  




* Set portfolio\-level governance, cadence, and predictability standards; oversee delivery health across all accounts.
* Be the final escalation point for your portfolio — internal and customer — resolving what Engagement Managers can’t.
* Confirm readiness and own go/no\-go at the portfolio level for major go\-lives.



  





 Adoption \& Product Feedback
 



  




* Drive adoption across accounts — ensure users reach value and stay to value, not just go\-



 live.
 



 Feed structured, prioritised customer insight back into product to shape the roadmap.
 



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 12–16 years in enterprise SaaS delivery, customer success, engagement / account management, or product / solution consulting — with real portfolio and people\-leadership experience.
* You’ve owned delivery, outcomes and retention / expansion for enterprise accounts.
* You develop people by doing — you show Engagement Managers what good looks like.
* You operate at executive level — calm, structured communication and confident escalation ownership.
* You’re pragmatic under pressure, with a critical\-path focus.
* Procurement / supply chain / spend\-management domain exposure and strong B2B SaaS understanding.
* You’re comfortable holding both delivery and commercial accountability across an enterprise portfolio.
* Bonus: experience with Indian \& US enterprise customers; MBA preferred.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Own a portfolio and its value end\-to\-end, with a team of Engagement Managers.
* A senior mandate to shape how enterprise value is delivered — with authority and ownership.
* A direct line to leadership, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions.
* Influence product direction through structured portfolio insight.
* A high\-growth environment scaling from $4M → $25M ARR and beyond.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If owning enterprise value at portfolio scale — and leading the people who deliver it — excites
 



 you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

title: Global Banking & Markets - Risk Governance - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**About Goldman Sachs**
 Goldman Sachs is a leading global financial institution that delivers a broad range of financial services across investment banking, securities, investment management, consumer banking, and wealth management. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in major financial centers around the world.
   

  

**GBM PRIVATE NON\-FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT**
 We are seeking an experienced operational risk professional to join GBM Private Non\-Financial Risk Management, supporting the franchise in managing and strengthening its operational risk profile. The role covers GBM Private business activities, products, transaction lifecycles, controls, and regional workflows, with a focus on governance, risk discipline, and franchise resilience. The successful candidate will bring strong risk judgment, analytical curiosity, clear communication, and the ability to challenge stakeholders and drive practical improvements.
   

  

**Job Summary \& Responsibilities**
* Provide front\-to\-back non\-financial risk coverage across GBM Private, identifying and mitigating key risks across products, processes, and transaction lifecycles.
* Advise and challenge stakeholders on risk mitigation, ensuring issues and remediation plans are clearly defined, owned, and tracked.
* Analyze risk data to identify trends, themes, and matters requiring management attention.
* Support operational risk event reviews, including root cause analysis, residual risk assessment, lessons learned, and remediation tracking.
* Conduct targeted risk reviews and recommend practical actions to address control gaps.
* Support quarterly RCSA activities by assessing risks, controls, effectiveness, and thematic remediation needs.
* Assess non\-financial risk impacts from new initiatives, acquisitions, migrations, and strategic developments.
* Drive risk discussions and governance forums, presenting clear conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross\-functional responses to market or risk events, supporting issue triage and timely decisions.
* Prepare clear reporting and presentations for senior management and governance forums.
* Improve risk reporting, analytics, governance, automation, data quality, and KRI usage.
* Challenge and enhance risk and control frameworks, promoting risk awareness and stronger controls.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to share best practices and develop integrated risk solutions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Graduate/Masters with 12 years of expereince
* Relevant experience in non\-financial risk, operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, audit, consulting, financial services operations, or a related control function; typically 7\+ years.
* Risk and control mindset, with curiosity to understand how risks arise and how controls can be improved.
* Analytical capability, with comfort using risk data, metrics, trends, and reporting outputs to identify themes, areas of heightened risk, and opportunities for control enhancement.
* Familiarity with GBM products, transaction lifecycles, and end\-to\-end operational flows is preferred, but not required. Candidates with relevant risk and control experience from adjacent financial services, operations, audit, compliance, or consulting backgrounds and an interest in developing GBM product knowledge will also be considered.
* Experience with data analysis, reporting, automation, or visualization tools such as Excel, Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI, Python, VBA, or similar technologies.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain issues, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders at different levels.
* Effective influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus, and support continuous enhancement of the control environment.
* Ownership, accountability, sound judgment, and ability to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Highly motivated and organized, with sound time management skills and the ability to prioritize effectively across multiple deliverables.
* Innovative mindset, with interest in using automation, analytics, emerging technologies, and low\-code solutions to improve risk monitoring, reporting, and governance processes.
* Exceptional candidates who do not meet every listed requirement but demonstrate risk judgment, ownership, analytical capability, and potential to grow into the role will be considered

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.

* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

title: Lead Operations Research Scientist
description:
**Role\- Lead Operations Research Scientist – Supply Chain Network Optimization**
**Target**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Supply Chain Network Optimization (SCNO) is a global team and part of Integrated Operations Planning \& Network steering within Global Supply Chain and Logistics. We are at the forefront of defining and enabling an efficient, reliable and best in class supply chain. This team uses a wide variety of engineering and advanced applied mathematical techniques (5Why’s, ML, AI, OR, MILP, DES,) techniques to study and solve niche problems in supply chain across the entire value chain (Planning, purchasing, transportation, multi echelon inventory, last mile and process optimization) to enable the best guest experience and profitable growth for Target.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead Operations Research Scientist in SCNO, you will tackle complex supply chain challenges, develop a deep understanding of problem complexity, and drive cutting\-edge solutions. This role requires strong experience working with large data sets, advanced programming skills, and a solid foundation in statistics, probability theory, machine learning, AI, simulations (such as Monte Carlo and discrete event simulation), and operations research.
   

  

 You will be expected to work effectively on high\-visibility problems that come with inherent risks, roadblocks, and constraints, while collaborating closely with cross\-functional stakeholders. You will also be accountable for planning and delivering team projects, ensuring alignment across teams, and driving measurable impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Identify large scale problem spaces aligned to enterprise priorities. Actively engage with cross\-functional business stakeholders to structure the ambiguous problems.
* Work with \& guide junior researchers to gather, analyze, and process large data sets to identify problems and root causes.
* Develop and apply advanced operations research techniques, applied AI, and machine learning methods to solve multi\-dimensional business problems.
* Build and run complex simulations, conduct scenario analyses, and employ optimization methods.
* Plan and develop project charters with clearly defined milestones and success metrics.
* Build cross\-functional alignment, remove blockers to accelerate project delivery.
* Communicate insights effectively through clear and concise storytelling to influence decision\-making.


 Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
   

  

**About You**
* Retail or Supply Chain experience is a must have.
* 12\+ years of professional experience with a master’s degree or 8\+ years for a PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics or Statistics. 1\-2 yrs experience in Applied AI is an advantage.
* 8\+ years of experience applying advanced data science and operations research techniques.
* 6\+ years of experience with programming in Python, PySpark and open\-source data science tools.
* Strong problem structuring and solving skills with the ability to address business challenges creatively.
* Team\-oriented with the ability to collaborate effectively across locations and time zones.
* Passionate about continuous learning and empirical research, with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing a team of 3\-4 OR/Data scientists is a plus.


**Why Work with Us at Target?**
* Work on advanced analytics and data science initiatives that directly impact Target’s value chain, including planning \& purchasing strategies, inventory planning, transportation efficiency, and 4\-walls optimization.
* We support your professional growth through learning and development opportunities.
* We value diversity and inclusion, fostering an environment that contributes to positive customer experiences.
* We offer flexible work schedules and arrangements, allowing team members to succeed both at work and in their personal lives in a hybrid setting.


**Useful Links to Learn More About Target and Our Benefits**
* Life at Target: https://india.target.com/
* Benefits: https://india.target.com/life\-at\-target/workplace/benefits

description:
Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power a new era of infrastructure – combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production\-ready solutions.

 We are looking for an Engineering Director in the infrastructure solutions software team in our CE\-SW group who will shape how our future infrastructure platforms are validated, from pre\-silicon development through silicon bring\-up and deployment. You will lead all aspects of an engineering group of 50\+ professionals working remotely across the intersection of silicon, firmware, and system software.

**Responsibilities**
 You will:
   

  

* Own and drive the validation and quality strategy for our Infrastructure System Solutions, providing technical direction across SoC, firmware and end\-to\-end system validation, from pre\-silicon development to production readiness.
* Build and lead a high\-performing, globally distributed Software Engineering organization, driving scalable automation, CI, quality metrics and engineering practices while developing strong engineering leadership at all levels.
* Partner with senior leaders across hardware, software, architecture and product teams to align validation with product goals, manage quality risks and influence key engineering and release decisions.

* Extensive experience delivering complex system software and leading large, globally distributed engineering organizations through managers and technical leaders.
* Strong technical background in System\-on\-Chip (SoC), firmware, platform software and system\-level validation across pre\-silicon and silicon environments.
* Deep expertise in validation strategy, test automation, continuous integration, regression and release readiness for complex systems.

* Knowledge of server\-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization.

 As soon as possible

 We are looking for an organised and proactive E\-commerce Operations Manager to take ownership of our Shopify store, improve the online customer experience and support the growth of our e\-commerce business.
 





 Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Shopify, online growth, website maintenance and digital content. The remaining 30% will cover related product operations, sourcing coordination, logistics and reporting.

* Maintain vendor due\-diligence, sustainability, B Corp and impact\-related records.

**About The Role**
 While you will oversee day\-to\-day delivery, your primary focus will be on building a structured, scalable operating model and leading a team that can deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 You will work closely with the TD COE, acting as a reliable operations partner, and play a key role in bringing more predictability, stronger governance, and better use of data into how learning programs are delivered.
   

  

 The role is part of the India HR Shared Services organization and a member of the India HRSS leadership team, providing an opportunity to contribute not just to learning operations, but to the broader shared services transformation journey.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end learning operations across regions, ensuring consistent and high\-quality execution
* Partner closely with the Talent Development team to translate learning plans into structured and executable delivery plans
* Bring discipline and predictability to planning, scheduling, and delivery in a high\-volume environment
* Use data and reporting to generate insights that support program governance and decision\-making
* Manage multi\-country delivery, balancing global consistency with local execution realities
* Own LMS operations including course setup, learning paths, and issue resolution
* Manage vendors and ensure quality delivery aligned to expectations
* Oversee financial processes including purchase orders and invoicing
* Lead and develop a team – set clear expectations, delegate effectively, and build capability beyond transactional execution

**Skills \& Experience**

* Proven experience in managing and developing teams
* Ability to operate at both execution and strategic levels
* Strong stakeholder management skills, especially in working with COEs and cross\-functional partners
* Comfort working with data and using insights to guide decisions
* Familiarity with LMS platforms and learning delivery models
* Ability to handle high\-volume, fast\-paced environments
* Strong problem\-solving and prioritization skills
* Experience working across regions or in multi\-country environments is preferred
* 10–15 years of relevant experience


 Why Join Us
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to lead a team, partner closely with Talent Development, and help shape how learning operations evolve within HR Shared Services.
